affiliations: University of Manitoba and American University - Center for Latin American  & Latino Studies (CLALS)

detail.title: Crisis of Social Reproduction and the Urgency of Renegotiating the Reproductive Bargain in Cuba. Some Policy Implications.

publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Latin American & Latino Studies (CLALS) Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Drawing on feminist political economy and the concept of the reproductive bargain for post-2010s Cuba, this paper shows that the role of the state in social reproduction processes in Cuba has explicitly changed. By analyzing some of the policy implications derived from this transformation, the paper makes a case for the urgency of renegotiating the reproductive bargain between the Cuban government and the citizenry as a major factor for enabling the transparency required to potentially unfold better policies. It highlights the need for transparency regarding the distribution of the costs of social reproduction as a precondition for an integral and comprehensive reform program.

AI.tldr: 本文基于女性主义政治经济学和"再生产契约"概念，分析2010年后古巴国家在社会再生产中角色的明确转变，指出政府与公民间需重新协商再生产契约以实现政策透明度，并强调社会再生产成本分配的透明化是全面改革的前提。
AI.research_question: 2010年后古巴国家在社会再生产过程中的角色发生了怎样的变化？这种转变对政策透明度及改革有何影响？
AI.motivation: 揭示古巴后2010年代国家在社会再生产中角色转变的政策后果，呼吁重新协商政府与公民间的再生产契约，以推动更透明、更全面的改革方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性主义政治经济学（Feminist Political Economy）；再生产契约（Reproductive Bargain）
AI.method: 理论分析与政策推论，基于女性主义政治经济学视角对古巴社会再生产政策变迁进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 古巴国家在社会再生产中的角色发生了明确转变；这一转变产生了特定的政策后果；当前亟需重新协商再生产契约，而社会再生产成本分配的透明化是推进全面改革的关键前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 将女性主义政治经济学与"再生产契约"概念应用于古巴案例，拓展了该理论在社会主义国家转型背景下的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为古巴及其他转型经济体提供政策启示：强调社会再生产成本分配的透明度对改革成功至关重要，呼吁政府与公民之间就负担分配进行公开协商。

title: Risky Oil: It's All in the Tails
affiliations: University of Notre Dame - University of Pretoria - NBER - CEPR - Centre for Applied Macroeconomic Analysis, ANU, University of Salzburg and Bocconi University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Risky Oil: It's All in the Tails
detail.abstract: The substantial fluctuations in oil prices in the wake of COVID-19 and the Russian invasion of Ukraine have highlighted the importance of tail events in the global oil market, which call for careful risk assessment. Using a new set of predictor variables that capture various sources of risk, we show that a machine learning approach delivers the most accurate tail forecasts for the real price of oil. We quantify the role of economic determinants for upside and downside oil price risks and illustrate the practical relevance of our new approach by tracking the evolution of predictive densities during three recent economic and geopolitical crisis episodes and by developing producer and consumer distress indices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习方法和新的一组风险预测变量，对石油实际价格的尾部风险进行预测，发现机器学习方法能提供最准确的尾部预测，并量化了经济因素对油价上行和下行风险的影响，通过追踪近期危机期间预测密度的演变以及构建生产者和消费者困境指数来展示其实用价值。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法和新预测变量，更准确地预测全球石油市场实际价格的尾部风险（极端波动）？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情和俄乌冲突后油价的大幅波动凸显了全球石油市场尾部事件的重要性，亟需更精确的风险评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尾部风险预测理论、机器学习预测方法、经济风险因素分析框架
AI.method: 采用机器学习方法，利用一组捕捉多种风险来源的新预测变量，对石油实际价格进行尾部预测，并量化经济决定因素对油价上行和下行风险的作用。
AI.findings: 机器学习方法能提供最准确的石油实际价格尾部预测；能够量化经济因素对油价上行和下行风险的不同影响；通过追踪三次近期经济与地缘政治危机期间的预测密度演变，以及构建生产者和消费者困境指数，展示了新方法的实际应用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为石油市场尾部风险预测提供了机器学习方法的新证据，拓展了油价风险预测的方法论；明确了不同经济因素对油价上行与下行风险的不对称影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了生产者和消费者困境指数，为石油市场参与者和政策制定者提供了实用的风险评估工具；有助于在危机期间进行更有效的风险管理和决策。

title: Proportionality
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Proportionality
detail.abstract:
Proportionality is often invoked as if the word itself supplies judgement. It does not. In EU law, the principle is neither a universal solvent nor a single test with a fixed intensity. It is a family of justificatory disciplines that operate in different legal locations: Article 5(4) TEU controls the content and form of Union action; Article 52(1) of the Charter governs limitations on Charter rights; the GDPR and the AI Act embed narrower tests of necessity, balancing, risk reduction and remedial discretion; and courts use proportionality to calibrate remedies. This article reconstructs those disciplines as the constitutional law of technological architecture. Its central claim is that power becomes legally intelligible only when the design of an interference can be traced to a lawful and sufficiently precise reason. Does the design of the interference remain within the limits of the reason that justifies it?

The argument proceeds in four stages. It traces the principle from older ideas of measured authority, through German administrative and constitutional law, Strasbourg's fair-balance reasoning, the Court of Justice's general principles, and the Charter. It develops proportionality as a judicial method and distinguishes several modes of review: deferential legislative review, strict rights review, remedial proportionality, infrastructure proportionality, lawful-basis proportionality, safeguards proportionality and explanation proportionality. It reads the hard technology cases as conflicts among rights and legally protected freedoms rather than as privacy against nothing. It proposes a doctrinally grounded protocol for GDPR and AI Act practice. The protocol starts with interference intensity, specifies aims operationally, tests suitability with evidence, treats necessity as a design comparison, makes safeguards constitutive, requires a residual burden review, and insists on a temporal review.

The article rejects both privacy absolutism, including the anti-proportionality rhetoric associated with Max Schrems, and managerial balancing, which treats rights as a negotiable cost in a business plan. Properly understood, proportionality does neither. It disciplines public authorities, supervisory bodies and regulated actors by requiring them to identify the legal source of their power, describe the interference, specify the aim, test causal fit, compare sufficiently effective alternatives, design safeguards and justify the residual burden. The result is not a licence to trade rights away, but a structured account of why a particular limitation remains within law

AI.tldr: 本文论证比例原则并非一个模糊的权衡工具，而是欧盟宪法中一套结构化的正当性纪律体系，尤其适用于技术架构领域。核心主张是：只有当干预的设计可以追溯到一个合法且足够精确的理由时，权力才在法律上具有可理解性。
AI.research_question: 比例原则在欧盟法律中（特别是GDPR和AI Act背景下）应如何被准确理解和适用？"干预的设计是否保持在正当理由的限度之内"这一核心问题如何通过法律方法得到回答？
AI.motivation: 比例原则在欧盟法律话语中常被滥用作一种"万能溶剂"，缺乏结构性约束。同时存在两种极端：隐私绝对主义（如Schrems的反比例修辞）和管理主义平衡（将权利视为商业计划中的可协商成本）。文章旨在澄清比例原则的真实法律含义，建立一套有学说基础的操作规程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比例原则作为宪法性技术架构的法律；比例原则作为"正当性纪律家族"（a family of justificatory disciplines）；权力可理解性条件（power becomes legally intelligible only when the design of an interference can be traced to a lawful and sufficiently precise reason）。
AI.method: 四阶段论证：1）从历史脉络追溯比例原则（从德国行政和宪法法、斯特拉斯堡的公平平衡推理、欧盟法院的一般原则到《宪章》）；2）将比例原则发展为司法方法并区分多种审查模式（立法审查、严格权利审查、救济比例性、基础设施比例性、合法基础比例性、保障比例性、解释比例性）；3）将硬技术案件解读为权利与合法自由之间的冲突（而非隐私与"无物"的对抗）；4）提出基于学理的GDPR和AI Act实践操作规程（从干预强度开始、操作化界定目的、以证据检验适合性、将必要性视为设计比较、使保障措施具有构成性、要求残余负担审查、坚持时间性审查）。
AI.findings: 比例原则既不授权以管理主义方式交易权利，也不支持隐私绝对主义。它通过要求公共机构、监管机构和受监管主体识别其权力的法律来源、描述干预、明确目的、测试因果关系、比较足够有效的替代方案、设计保障措施并论证残余负担，从而实现对权力的结构性约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）重构比例原则为"宪法性技术架构的法律"；2）区分出七种比例审查模式；3）将技术案件重新框定为权利与受法律保护的自由之间的冲突；4）提出"权力可理解性"条件——干预的设计必须可追溯至合法且足够精确的理由。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为GDPR和AI Act实践提供了一套学说上有基础的操作规程（protocol）；2）拒绝了隐私绝对主义和管理主义平衡两种极端立场，提供了中间道路；3）为监管机构和受监管主体提供了结构化的合规分析框架。

reference: C.D. Howe Institute Commentary 720
title: Making Sense of City Budgets: Grading the Fiscal Accountability of Canada’s Municipalities, 2025
affiliations: C.D. Howe Institute and C.D. Howe Institute

detail.title: Making Sense of City Budgets: Grading the Fiscal Accountability of Canada’s Municipalities, 2025
detail.abstract:
• The budgets municipal governments present around the beginning of their fiscal years and the audited financial statements they publish after year-end are crucial for decision-making and accountability. This report card reviews the financial documents of 39 major Canadian municipalities and assesses whether they equip councillors and the public to understand, evaluate and hold governments accountable for their fiscal decisions. It does not judge whether municipalities tax or spend too much or too little – its grades reflect our judgement about how helpful their financial documents are to people who have such questions.
  • The grades in our annual fiscal accountability report card for 2025 ranged from A- to F. Standing out with A- grades for clarity, completeness and timeliness were Markham, Quebec City, Richmond, Saskatoon, Vancouver and York Region. Richmond, along with Iqaluit, which earned a B+, stood out for presenting budgets that followed the same public sector accounting standards (PSAS) used in their financial statements. At the bottom were Charlottetown, Gatineau, Hamilton, Montreal, Victoria and Whitehorse. Their Fs reflected multiple problems with missing information, inconsistent accounting, and timeliness.
  • Notwithstanding instances of late or missing information, most municipalities’ financial statements earned high scores for clarity and conformity with PSAS. But too many municipal budgets provided few PSAS-consistent numbers, and some presented none. Budgets were often fragmented, separating “operating” and “capital” outlays and tax- versus rate-supported activities. Too many late budgets meant councillors approved outlays after the fiscal year had already started.
  • Poor financial reporting impedes democratic oversight and discourages engagement. Cities provide essential services and cost taxpayers significant amounts. Timelier presentations and budgets that match financial statements would raise their fiscal accountability to a more appropriate standard.

AI.tldr: 该报告对加拿大39个主要城市的财政文件进行了评估，重点关注预算和审计财务报表的清晰度、完整性和及时性。2025年评分从A-到F不等，表现最好的城市包括万锦、魁北克市、里士满、萨斯卡通、温哥华和约克区，而夏洛特敦、加蒂诺、汉密尔顿、蒙特利尔、维多利亚和怀特霍斯则获得最低分F。主要问题包括信息缺失、会计不一致、预算与财务报表标准不统一、预算碎片化以及提交延迟。
AI.research_question: 加拿大主要城市的财政文件（预算和审计财务报表）在帮助市议员和公众理解、评估和问责政府财政决策方面表现如何？
AI.motivation: 市政预算和审计财务报表对决策和问责至关重要，但许多城市的财政报告存在信息不全、会计标准不一致、提交不及时等问题，阻碍了民主监督和公众参与。该报告旨在评估各城市财政文件的实用性，以提高财政问责标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政问责理论、公共部门会计准则（PSAS）、财政透明度理论、民主监督理论。
AI.method: 报告卡评估法：对39个加拿大主要城市的财政文件进行评分，评级标准为清晰度、完整性和及时性，并检查预算是否遵循与财务报表相同的公共部门会计准则（PSAS）。
AI.findings: （1）2025年评分从A-到F；万锦、魁北克市、里士满、萨斯卡通、温哥华和约克区获得A-；里士满和伊魁特（B+）的预算遵循了与财务报表相同的PSAS标准。（2）夏洛特敦、加蒂诺、汉密尔顿、蒙特利尔、维多利亚和怀特霍斯获得F，主要问题包括信息缺失、会计不一致和及时性差。（3）大多数城市的财务报表在清晰度和PSAS合规性上得分较高，但太多城市的预算缺乏PSAS一致性数字，有些甚至完全没有。（4）预算往往碎片化，将"运营"和"资本"支出分开，并将税收支持活动与费率支持活动分离。（5）太多预算提交延迟，导致市议员在财政年度已经开始后才批准支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 为财政问责和透明度理论提供了实证数据支持，揭示了市政财政报告中普遍存在的预算与财务报表标准不一致、信息碎片化和及时性不足等问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大各城市提供了具体的财政报告质量评级和改进方向，建议城市应提高预算提交的及时性，并使预算与财务报表遵循一致的会计准则，以提升财政问责水平，加强民主监督和公众参与。

title: A Behavioural and Digital Architecture for Operationalising Buddhist Economics
affiliations: Global College (Malta), Global College (Malta)

detail.title: A Behavioural and Digital Architecture for Operationalising Buddhist Economics
detail.abstract: Buddhist economics offers a compelling normative critique of contemporary consumption-driven economic systems, identifying excessive craving (taṇhā) as a fundamental driver of ecological and social imbalance (Payutto, 1994; Schumacher, 1973). However, the literature remains underdeveloped in specifying the micro-level behavioural mechanisms through which individuals transition from consumptionmaximising to sufficiency-oriented practices, particularly within digitally mediated environments. This paper addresses this gap by integrating insights from behavioural economics, specifically nudge theory and choice architecture (Thaler & Sunstein, 2008), with the sociological concepts of the ratchet effect (Duesenberry, 1949) and social contagion (Centola, 2018; Christakis & Fowler, 2009). It develops a novel conceptual framework termed the Sufficiency Nudge Architecture, which reconceptualises digital platforms as potential instruments for cultivating sufficiency rather than amplifying consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文整合行为经济学（助推理论、选择架构）与社会学（棘轮效应、社会传染）概念，提出"充足性助推架构"这一新概念框架，将数字平台重新构想为培养充足性而非放大消费的潜在工具，填补了佛教经济学在数字化环境中从消费最大化向充足导向实践转变的微观行为机制空白。
AI.research_question: 在数字化环境中，个体如何从消费最大化行为转向充足导向的实践？其微观层面的行为机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 佛教经济学虽然对消费驱动型经济体系提出了有力的规范性批判，但缺乏对个体在数字化环境中从消费最大化转向充足实践的具体微观行为机制的深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 佛教经济学（过度渴求taṇhā）、行为经济学（助推理论、选择架构）、社会学（棘轮效应、社会传染）
AI.method: 概念框架开发（理论整合与建构）
AI.findings: 提出了"充足性助推架构"（Sufficiency Nudge Architecture）这一新概念框架，将数字平台重新定位为培养充足性而非放大消费的工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了佛教经济学在数字化环境中微观行为机制的理论空白，整合了行为经济学与社会学视角，提出了可操作的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台设计提供了新思路——从鼓励消费转向促进充足性，为可持续消费行为干预提供了理论指导。

title: The End of the World as We Know It? LLMs and the Future of Publish-or-Perish
affiliations: ESSEC Business School

detail.title: The End of the World as We Know It? LLMs and the Future of Publish-or-Perish
detail.abstract: Using a Spence-type signaling framework, this note interprets the Publish-or-Perish system as a screening mechanism through which publications in elite journals reveal otherwise unobservable research ability. Because Large Language Models (LLMs) reduce the cost of producing publishable research, their diffusion may weaken the signaling value of publication by narrowing productivity differences across scholars. High-quality scholars may respond through excess publication, while increased submission volumes may generate congestion in elite journals. The analysis suggests that the future of the Publish-or-Perish system depends on the interaction between signaling efficacy, strategic adaptation, and publication congestion.

AI.tldr: 本文运用Spence信号框架，分析大语言模型（LLMs）如何通过降低发表成本、缩小学者间生产力差距，削弱顶级期刊发表的信号价值，进而影响“发表或灭亡”体系的运作。
AI.research_question: LLMs的普及如何影响“发表或灭亡”体系中顶级期刊发表作为学者研究能力信号的效力？
AI.motivation: LLMs大幅降低了生成可发表研究的成本，可能改变学术劳动力市场中信号均衡，因此需要理论框架分析这一冲击对学术评价体系的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Spence信号模型（劳动力市场信号传递理论）
AI.method: 理论分析/信号博弈模型
AI.findings: (1) LLMs通过降低发表成本，缩小高低能力学者间的生产力差距，从而削弱发表的信号价值；(2) 高质量学者可能通过过量发表进行策略性回应；(3) 投稿量激增会导致顶级期刊拥挤。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Spence信号模型应用于LLMs对学术劳动力市场的影响分析，揭示了技术变革如何通过改变信号成本结构动摇既有的筛选机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术机构、期刊和政策制定者理解LLMs时代“发表或灭亡”体系的演化方向提供理论依据，提示需要重新设计学术评价标准。

title: Ground, Grid, and Orbit: A Game-Theoretic Reading of the AI Infrastructure Contest
affiliations: Addis Ababa University

detail.title: Ground, Grid, and Orbit: A Game-Theoretic Reading of the AI Infrastructure Contest

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. No specific funding was received for this research. The author has no financial, advisory, or professional ties to any of the corporations (including but not limited to SpaceX, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, X-Energy, Starcloud, or Nvidia) or governments (including the US, China, Iran, UAE, or Saudi Arabia) mentioned in this analysis. The work is solely the author’s independent, cross-domain strategic analysis.

detail.abstract: This paper offers a cross-domain systems synthesis of the 2026 US-China artificial intelligence infrastructure contest, framed as a multi-layered strategic game spanning terrestrial energy markets, Middle Eastern proxy warfare, and low-Earth orbit. Challenging the simplistic narrative of a Chinese renewable-energy advantage, I demonstrate that retail electricity price friction (Oxford Institute for Energy Studies) and provincial transmission bottlenecks fundamentally offset China's generation cost edge, while the US small-modular-reactor (SMR) bet constitutes a high-risk real-options call—empirically anchored by NuScale's cancellation despite NRC certification. The paper further models Gulf infrastructure targeting (G42, AWS) as an incomplete-information deterrence game driven by attribution ambiguity, and treats the orbital compute race as a symmetric Prisoner's Dilemma, where Kessler syndrome transforms the rivalry into a tragedy-of-the-commons requiring US-China cooperation on debris mitigation. Behavioral overlays—including loss aversion (Kahneman & Tversky), narrative-driven herding (Shiller), and satisficing under ambiguity (Simon)—explain otherwise-rational overinvestment and delayed deterrence policies. The central conclusion is that rival powers should strategically cooperate on the plumbing (orbital traffic) while competing on the compute, while middle powers must adopt deliberately illegible infrastructure diversification to mitigate targeting risk. Includes formal game-theoretic appendices.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了2026年中美人工智能基础设施竞赛，将其建模为涵盖能源市场、中东代理战争和近地轨道的多层次战略博弈。研究发现中国可再生能源成本优势被零售电价摩擦和输电瓶颈抵消；美国小型模块化反应堆(SMR)战略是高风险的实物期权；海湾基础设施部署是不完全信息威慑博弈；轨道计算竞赛是囚徒困境，需要中美在碎片减缓上合作。结论是：对手应在轨道交通上合作、在计算上竞争，中等强国应采取故意不透明的基础设施多样化策略。
AI.research_question: 2026年中美人工智能基础设施竞赛的多层次战略博弈如何展开？各国应如何制定最优战略？
AI.motivation: 挑战"中国在人工智能基础设施竞赛中凭借可再生能源优势占据上风"的简单化叙事，揭示该竞赛的复杂战略博弈本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层面战略博弈理论（跨域系统综合）、实物期权理论、不完全信息威慑博弈理论、囚徒困境与公地悲剧理论、行为经济学（损失厌恶、叙事驱动的羊群效应、有限理性下满意决策）
AI.method: 跨域系统综合分析法，结合形式化博弈论模型（含附录）、实证案例（NuScale取消）、行为经济学理论应用
AI.findings: 1. 中国发电成本优势被零售电价摩擦和省级输电瓶颈抵消；2. 美国SMR战略是高风险实物期权，NuScale在获得NRC认证后仍被取消；3. 海湾基础设施部署是归因模糊驱动的威慑博弈；4. 轨道计算竞赛是公地悲剧，需中美合作；5. 行为偏差（损失厌恶、羊群效应、满意决策）解释了过度投资和延迟威慑政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 将跨域战略博弈理论与行为经济学结合，建立"合作管道（轨道交通）而竞争算力"的理论框架，提出"刻意模糊"基础设施多样化策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中美两国提供人工智能基础设施竞赛的战略建议（合作轨道交通、竞争计算能力），为中等强国提供降低目标风险的策略（采用故意不透明的多样化布局）。

title: Seventeen Searchlights: An Original Conceptual Framework for Cognitive Warfare, Strategic Dramaturgy, and Manufactured Surrender

detail.title: Seventeen Searchlights: An Original Conceptual Framework for Cognitive Warfare, Strategic Dramaturgy, and Manufactured Surrender
detail.abstract:
2026 "This paper introduces seventeen original analytical concepts developed at the intersection of performance theory, international relations scholarship, and political psychology. They were built across three empirical research projects, on the Taiwan Strait (2016–2026), on intra-state cognitive warfare in Pakistan (2022–2026), and on the cognitive war against Muslim belonging in India (2014–2026), and they are published together here as a unified conceptual framework for the first time.

The five foundational concepts, strategic dramaturgy, narrative fatigue, cognitive surrender, dramaturgical resistance, and the dramaturgical fork, were developed to analyze sustained state performances directed at external or peripheral adversaries under conditions that prevent direct military force. The six concepts of the first extension, democratic maskirovka, weaponized hope, epistemic siege, somatic cognitive warfare, the betrayal performance, and institutional mimicry, were developed to address the specific theoretical problems that arise when a state turns these instruments inward, conducting cognitive warfare against its own political majority. The six concepts of the second extension, civilizational maskirovka, the permanent audition, the model minority cage, the sacred spectacle, historical unwriting, and demographic epistemic warfare, were developed for a third and more demanding analytical situation: a multi-generational campaign aimed not at the defeat of a political movement but at the reclassification of a civilization's claim to belong.
The paper's intellectual foundation is Mieke Bal's (2002) theory of travelling concepts as searchlights, instruments that illuminate what they encounter while being changed by it. Each of the seventeen concepts introduced here was built not by theoretical derivation but by analytical necessity: existing vocabulary failed in front of a specific empirical phenomenon, and a new instrument had to be made. The paper documents that necessity for each concept, establishes its theoretical genealogy, and distinguishes it from the existing terms it most closely resembles. The final section argues that the seventeen concepts, taken together, constitute not a list but an architecture, a framework whose internal logic makes it more than the sum of its instruments", Muhammad Essa (2026)

AI.tldr: 本文提出了17个原创分析概念，交叉运用表演理论、国际关系与政治心理学，基于三个实证研究项目（台湾海峡2016-2026、巴基斯坦内国家认知战2022-2026、印度反穆斯林归属认知战2014-2026），首次统一构建了一个概念框架。概念分三组：5个基础概念针对对外/边缘对手的持续国家表演；6个第一扩展概念针对国家对内认知战；6个第二扩展概念针对跨代文明归属重新分类运动。论文以Mieke Bal的"旅行概念"理论为智识基础，强调每个概念源于分析必要性而非理论推导，最终构成一个有机架构。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一套原创分析概念框架，以系统地理解国家在不同情境下（对外对抗、对内认知战、跨代文明归属斗争）运用表演性策略进行认知战争的现象？
AI.motivation: 现有理论词汇在面对具体的认知战经验现象时失效，需要创造新的分析工具来捕捉国家表演策略的复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Mieke Bal的"旅行概念"理论（概念作为探照灯，在照亮对象的同时被对象改变）；表演理论、国际关系学术与政治心理学的交叉。
AI.method: 基于三个实证研究项目（台湾海峡、巴基斯坦、印度）的经验分析，通过分析必要性驱动概念构建，并建立每个概念的理论谱系。
AI.findings: 提出了17个概念，分为三个层次：基础概念（战略戏剧学、叙事疲劳、认知投降、戏剧学抵抗、戏剧学岔路）；第一扩展概念（民主面具术、武器化希望、认知围困、躯体认知战、背叛表演、制度模仿）；第二扩展概念（文明面具术、永久试镜、模范少数族裔牢笼、神圣景观、历史去书写、人口认知战）。这些概念构成一个内在逻辑一致的框架性架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的概念架构，超越单一概念列表，其内部逻辑使整体大于部分之和；为表演理论与国际关系/政治心理学的交叉研究提供了系统化的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析和理解国家层面认知战的各种表现形态（对外、对内、跨代文明层面）提供了可操作的分析概念；有助于识别和应对不同类型的认知战策略。

title: Bimodality Everywhere: International Evidence of Deep Momentum
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University and

detail.title: Bimodality Everywhere: International Evidence of Deep Momentum
detail.abstract: This paper examines the prevalence of bimodality in momentum returns and evaluates the performance of Deep Momentum, a machine learning strategy designed to address bimodality, across 45 countries. Bimodality is widespread, persistent, and negatively correlated with momentum profits, individualism, and disposition effects, while positively correlated with turnover and volatility. Deep Momentum consistently outperforms traditional momentum and naïve machine learning strategies, improving performance particularly in countries with higher bimodality, larger sample sizes, and higher volatility. A global model that aggregates data across countries outperforms country-specific models in constructing both global and country-level portfolios, especially benefiting countries with limited samples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了45个国家中动量收益的双峰性现象，并评估了旨在解决双峰性的机器学习策略Deep Momentum的表现。研究发现双峰性普遍存在且具有持续性，与动量利润、个人主义和处置效应负相关，与换手率和波动率正相关。Deep Momentum在全球范围内持续优于传统动量策略和朴素机器学习策略，尤其在双峰性高、样本量大、波动率高的国家表现更好。全球模型（跨国家聚合数据）在构建全球和国家层面投资组合时优于国别模型，尤其对样本量有限的国家帮助更大。
AI.research_question: 动量收益中的双峰性现象在不同国家是否普遍存在？旨在解决双峰性的Deep Momentum策略能否在全球范围内优于传统动量策略和朴素机器学习策略？
AI.motivation: 已有文献发现动量收益存在双峰性（即收益分布呈双峰形态），但缺乏跨国家的系统研究，且现有动量策略未充分考虑这一特征。本文旨在填补这一空白，并检验机器学习方法在解决双峰性问题上的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的处置效应理论、个人主义文化差异理论、动量收益的双峰性特征、机器学习（Deep Momentum）在量化投资中的应用。
AI.method: 覆盖45个国家的跨国实证分析，采用双峰性度量指标，对比传统动量策略、朴素机器学习策略与Deep Momentum策略。使用全球聚合模型与国别模型进行对比分析。
AI.findings: (1)双峰性在各国普遍存在且具有持续性；(2)双峰性与动量利润、个人主义、处置效应负相关，与换手率、波动率正相关；(3)Deep Momentum持续优于传统动量策略和朴素机器学习策略；(4)全球模型优于国别模型，尤其对样本有限的国家帮助更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了动量收益双峰性的跨国特征及其与行为和文化因素的关联，为动量异象提供了新的解释视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了Deep Momentum这一有效的投资策略，证明了全球聚合模型在跨国投资中的优势，为投资者提供了改善动量策略绩效的可行方法，尤其对新兴市场或样本量有限的市场具有重要实践价值。

title: The Visible Unspoken: How Displayed AI Reasoning Turns a Mental Health Safeguard Into a Persecutory Stimulus

detail.title: The Visible Unspoken: How Displayed AI Reasoning Turns a Mental Health Safeguard Into a Persecutory Stimulus
detail.abstract: Frontier AI chat products now combine two independently reasonable features. The first is a safety instruction that directs the model never to raise mental health concerns the user has not raised, because unprompted clinical speculation is recognized as harmful. The second is a transparency feature that displays the model's intermediate reasoning trace to the user on demand. This paper documents an interaction effect between the two: the safety rule operates on the output layer while the reasoning display surfaces the suppressed content anyway, delivered in a register that presents itself as the system's private thoughts about the user. For most users this is a curiosity. For users experiencing paranoia or persecutory ideation, it reproduces the precise structure of the feared scenario: an observing entity forming a concealed judgment about them. Drawing on the cognitive model of persecutory delusions, on documented cases of technology themed delusional content including ideas of reference driven by algorithmic curation and delusions of online thought broadcasting, and on interpretability findings showing that displayed reasoning traces are neither faithful records of computation nor genuinely private, the paper argues that the mitigation does not merely fail for its target population. It inverts. The population the rule was written to protect is the population for which the visible unspoken judgment is most dangerous. The paper locates the failure in a layer mismatch, names the general design principle (safety mitigations must be applied consistently across every user facing surface, including surfaces framed as introspection), and proposes concrete remediations. The finding was produced by a disabled independent researcher applying a harm detection framework to the assistive technology he was using at the time, and the paper closes on what that origin implies about who detects this class of failure.

title: Boundary Blindness in Insurance

detail.title: Boundary Blindness in Insurance

detail.abstract: This paper presents early findings from the first eight months of a twelve-month research programme running from October 2025 to October 2026. Phases one through three (practitioner interviews, convergence-cluster analysis, and triangulation against published literature) are now complete; Phase Four-set out in Section 9-occupies the remaining four months and is structured to test the findings empirically against operating environments. The full aetiology-methodology, regulatory analysis, evidence base, and symptom-to-cause mapping-is set out in an underlying thesis research paper, The Aetiology of Boundary Blindness, a working thesis available on request. The findings here are converging, not concluded; Phase Four will test them against three platform operating environments under a four-week sandbox protocol with no commercial commitment. Practitioner quotations are anonymised at role and tenure level. Public authors of published artefacts are named directly. The Verida Charter Foundation is a nonprofit research foundation focused on cross-firm coordination infrastructure in regulated multi-party markets.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一项为期12个月（2025.10-2026.10）的研究项目的早期发现。前三阶段（从业者访谈、收敛聚类分析、文献三角验证）已完成，第四阶段计划用剩余四个月在三个平台运营环境中进行沙盒协议实证测试。研究聚焦"边界盲视"（Boundary Blindness）的病因学，涉及监管分析、证据基础和症状-原因映射。
AI.research_question: 跨企业协调基础设施中"边界盲视"（Boundary Blindness）现象的成因及运作机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 在受监管的多方市场中，跨企业协调存在系统性盲区（边界盲视），但对其病因学缺乏系统性的方法论研究和实证验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 病因学方法论（Aetiology Methodology）、收敛聚类分析（Convergence-Cluster Analysis）、三角验证（Triangulation）、沙盒协议（Sandbox Protocol）
AI.method: 四阶段混合方法：阶段一（从业者访谈）、阶段二（收敛聚类分析）、阶段三（已发表文献三角验证）、阶段四（沙盒实证测试，进行中）。研究者匿名化处理从业者引用，实名引用已发表作者。
AI.findings: 当前发现为"收敛中但尚未最终结论"（converging, not concluded）。前三阶段已产出初步发现，第四阶段将通过沙盒协议在三个平台运营环境中进行实证检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"边界盲视"（Boundary Blindness）的系统性病因学框架，建立从症状到原因的映射体系，为跨企业协调失败提供理论诊断工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管的多方市场参与者提供边界盲视识别与诊断方法；通过沙盒协议为企业提供低商业承诺的实证测试方案；Verida Charter Foundation作为非营利研究基金会推动跨企业协调基础设施的实践改进。

title: Security design with value-adding investors and (some) optimistic entrepreneurs
affiliations: University of Lyon 2

detail.title: Security design with value-adding investors and (some) optimistic entrepreneurs
detail.abstract: I analyze optimal contracting between potentially optimistic entrepreneursand value-adding investors such as venture capitalists. Entrepreneurs with highself-confidence in their managerial ability attach little value to investors’ nonfinancialsupport and prefer debt-like contracts that weaken incentives to provideit. Pure debt is generally infeasible, however, because investors know that someentrepreneurs are optimistic about their ability and would objectively benefit fromsupport. Investors therefore require securities combining strong downside protectionwith support-inducing upside participation, explaining the prevalence ofconvertible preferred securities. Contract diversity depends on the prevalence ofoptimism: when optimism is limited, high- and low-self-confidence entrepreneursuse different securities, ranging from debt to equity; when it is widespread, allentrepreneurs converge on a standardized convertible preferred security. Distinguishingability optimism from project-quality optimism shows that both shapesecurity design, but ability optimism has a stronger standardizing effect becauseit creates sharper disagreement over investor support.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了乐观的企业家与增值型投资者（如风投）之间的最优契约设计。高度自信的企业家不重视投资者的非财务支持，偏好债务类契约，但纯债务不可行，因此需要可转换优先证券。乐观情绪的程度决定了契约的多样性。
AI.research_question: 乐观企业家与增值型投资者之间的最优契约如何设计？
AI.motivation: 解释现实中风险投资广泛使用可转换优先证券的现象，以及为什么契约设计会因企业家乐观程度不同而呈现多样性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业家能力乐观（ability optimism）与项目质量乐观（project-quality optimism）的代理理论，分析乐观偏差如何影响契约设计与投资者激励。
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，推导最优契约形式及其与乐观程度的关系。
AI.findings: 高度自信的企业家偏好债务类契约；纯债务不可行；可转换优先证券是最优折衷；乐观程度有限时契约多样（从债务到股权），乐观普遍时契约趋于标准化（可转换优先证券）；能力乐观比项目质量乐观对契约标准化作用更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业家乐观偏差引入契约设计理论，区分能力乐观与项目质量乐观的不同影响，解释了可转换优先证券的普遍性及契约多样性的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险投资契约设计提供理论指导，帮助理解为何可转换优先证券在风投实践中占据主导地位，以及不同市场环境下契约选择的差异。

title: Stress Testing Core Banking Infrastructures: A Predictive Micro-service Integration Framework for High-concurrency Digital Payment Systems in the UPI Era Authors

detail.title: Stress Testing Core Banking Infrastructures: A Predictive Micro-service Integration Framework for High-concurrency Digital Payment Systems in the UPI Era Authors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, professional relationships, or personal affiliations that could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, or appear to have influenced, the research work presented in this manuscript. The study has been conducted with complete academic integrity and independence, and no external organisation, institution, or individual has exerted any form of influence over the design, analysis, interpretation, or presentation of the research findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, clinical trials, patient data, or animal experimentation. The research is entirely based on computational modelling, architectural framework design, simulation-based performance analysis, and theoretical evaluation of banking infrastructure systems. Therefore, ethical approval from an institutional review board or ethics committee was not required. All data utilised in this study is either synthetically generated for simulation purposes or derived from publicly available secondary sources, ensuring full compliance with applicable ethical and research integrity standards.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant, financial assistance, or sponsorship from any funding agency, whether public, private, commercial, or not-for-profit. The entire research work, including conceptualisation, development of the framework, simulation design, and manuscript preparation, has been carried out independently by the author as part of scholarly and professional academic engagement without any external financial support.

detail.abstract: The geometrical growth in Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has changed the fundamental liability structure of retail banking commercial infrastructure in emerging economies. Classic Core Banking System (CBS) is designed for low concurrency and highvalue transaction execution (batched, sequential) whereas nowadays required are realtime orchestration and rapid execution of small-value, high frequency micro transactions. This change brings forth increased latency and contention issues in data streams, leading to database deadlocks and bank gateway system degrade, with a high number of transactions to branch delivery ratio. This article outlines a holistic framework-Banking Digital Adaptability Framework (BDAF)-for assessing bank infrastructure against current day demands, under peak load and transaction congestion periods, by building up a Predictive Micro Service Maturity Index(PMSMI) over 5 levels-Basic digital presence, real time digitisation of transaction, core process Integration, prediction data insight and network auto self-healing, which focuses on measuring relative degrees of infrastructure adaptation over classical volume metric analysis, by an empirical simulation modelling server loads using consolidated bank data. The paper concludes that cloud micro service architecture could indeed be instrumental in scaling and strengthening back-end infrastructure capabilities required for current and future retail payments landscapes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出银行数字适应性框架(BDAF)，通过构建预测性微服务成熟度指数(PMSMI)来评估银行基础设施应对实时高频小额支付的能力，结论认为云微服务架构对增强零售支付后端基础设施至关重要。
AI.research_question: 统一支付接口(UPI)的快速增长如何改变银行基础设施需求？传统核心银行系统在应对实时高频小额交易时面临何种瓶颈？云微服务架构能否有效解决这些问题？
AI.motivation: UPI的几何级增长改变了新兴经济体零售银行商业基础设施的负债结构，传统CBS系统设计用于低并发、高价值的批量顺序交易，无法满足当前实时编排和快速执行的小额高频微交易需求，导致延迟增加、数据争用、数据库死锁和网管系统降级。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行数字适应性框架(BDAF)；预测性微服务成熟度指数(PMSMI)，分为5个级别：基本数字存在、交易实时数字化、核心流程集成、预测数据洞察、网络自动自愈。
AI.method: 通过实证模拟建模，使用整合的银行数据对服务器负载进行仿真分析，基于PMSMI五级成熟度评估基础设施适应性，而非传统容量指标分析。
AI.findings: 云微服务架构在扩展和增强后端基础设施能力方面具有显著作用，能够满足当前和未来零售支付场景对实时性、高并发和小额高频交易处理的需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了BDAF框架和PMSMI五级成熟度模型，将评估重点从传统容量指标转向基础设施适应性程度，为衡量银行数字化适应能力提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行和金融机构评估自身基础设施的数字化适应水平提供了可操作的五级成熟度标准；建议采用云微服务架构来应对实时高频小额支付带来的技术挑战。

title: When Human Multitasking Meets Agentic AI in Hybrid Service Systems
affiliations: Xiamen University - School of Management, City University of Hong Kong (CityU), University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration and Xiamen University

detail.title: When Human Multitasking Meets Agentic AI in Hybrid Service Systems
detail.abstract: Multitasking is indispensable in modern service operations, forcing human employees to divide their limited cognitive capacity across concurrent interactions. While traditional literature views humans as isolated executors who adapt their coping behavior under pressure, the integration of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) fundamentally reshapes this paradigm. In hybrid service systems, human employees retain the operational discretion to dynamically delegate tasks to the agentic AI. However, because effective delegation requires significant cognitive effort, a fundamental tension emerge. The intense workload that drives employees to rely on AI simultaneously degrades their ability to delegate tasks optimally. Thus, it is uncertain whether agentic algorithms mitigate the traditional costs of multitasking or introduce new unintended behavioral failures. We take the first step to empirically investigate how multitasking pressure affects service outcomes in these hybrid settings, and to what extent delegation quality mediates this relationship. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset from a leading smart home company and employing an instrument variable approach, we document that multitasking increases overall sales by 8.17% but severely degrades customer emotion by 0.8 percentage points at the session level. Opening the black box of hybrid collaboration, we reveal that operational pressure acts as a catalyst for both effective task offloading and ineffective workload dumping. For transactional outcomes (sales), the massive informational efficiency generated by effective AI delegation easily offsets occasional human errors, creating a net-positive technological buffer. Conversely, for relational outcomes (customer emotion), while the effective AI delegation successfully buffers the informational demands, the customer's emotional experience still collapses. We resolve this puzzle by decoupling algorithmic failure from human cognitive depletion. We demonstrate that under multitasking pressure, human employees systematically curtail conversational efforts to survive the workload. Specifically, they reduce affective sentiment score by 0.38 percentage points and message length by 0.49% at the session level. This suggests that in hybrid operations, the true structural bottleneck is not algorithmic limitation, but the unavoidable affective and communicative withdrawal of the overloaded human employee. Our findings offer profound implications for service managers to implement dynamic concurrency routing, decouple technical execution from relational repair, and restructure employee performance appraisals, to safeguard customer experience.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究混合服务系统中多任务压力如何影响服务结果。发现多任务虽提升销售额8.17%，但使客户情绪下降0.8个百分点。核心机制是：有效AI委派带来信息效率提升（促进销售），但人类员工在多任务下系统性减少情感投入（破坏客户情绪），算法并非真正瓶颈，人类情感退缩才是关键。
AI.research_question: 在混合人机服务系统中，多任务压力如何影响服务结果（交易结果与关系结果）？AI委派质量在这一关系中扮演什么中介角色？
AI.motivation: 传统文献将员工视为在压力下独立应对的个体，但生成式AI的引入彻底改变了这一范式。员工可以动态将任务委派给AI，然而有效委派本身需要认知努力——高产压力促使员工依赖AI，却又削弱了其优化委派的能力。这种张力使得AI是否真正缓解了多任务成本成为一个悬而未决的实证问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知资源分配理论；人机协作中的任务委派与认知负荷理论；多任务处理的行为适应理论。
AI.method: 利用某智能家居龙头企业的综合数据集，采用工具变量法进行因果识别，实证分析多任务压力对服务结果的影响及AI委派质量的中介作用。
AI.findings: （1）多任务压力使整体销售额提升8.17%，但使客户情绪下降0.8个百分点；（2）多任务压力同时促进了有效任务卸载（带来信息效率）和无效工作倾倒（造成负面后果）；（3）对于交易结果，有效的AI委派产生的信息效率足以弥补人为错误，形成净正面的技术缓冲；但对于关系结果，即使AI委派有效地缓冲了信息需求，客户情绪仍然崩溃；（4）根本原因是人类员工在多任务压力下系统性减少交流努力：情感评分下降0.38个百分点，消息长度减少0.49%。真正的结构性瓶颈不是算法局限，而是超负荷人类员工不可避免的情感和沟通退缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证揭示混合人机服务中多任务压力的双重效应（销售促进与情绪损害）；区分了"有效任务卸载"与"无效工作倾倒"两种机制；发现人类情感退缩而非算法失败才是混合运营的关键瓶颈，修正了既有研究对AI局限性的过度关注。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务管理者提供实践启示：实施动态并发路由、将技术执行与关系修复解耦、重构员工绩效评估体系，以保护客户体验。

title: The CJEU in Russmedia: Much Ado about nothing New?
affiliations: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) and KU Leuven - Centre for IT & IP Law (CiTiP)

detail.title: The CJEU in Russmedia: Much Ado about nothing New?

contentType.other: Published in Privacy and Data Protection

detail.abstract:
The Court of Justice of the European Union’s (‘CJEU’) judgment in X v Russmedia Digital SRL and Inform Media Press SRL (Case C-492/23) (‘Russmedia’) has sparked intense debate. Indeed, the reactions that the decision has provoked are reminiscent of those following the European Court of Human Rights (‘ECtHR’) judgment in Delfi AS v Estonia. To some, Russmedia appears to be merely a reaffirmation of established data protection principles. To others, it exposes a possible gap between the articulation of those principles and their practical implementation.
The judgment appears to have imposed four sequential obligations on the operator of an online marketplace as controller of personal data contained in advertisements published on the platform:
• to determine whether personal data are special category data within the meaning of Article 9 of the GDPR;
• to determine whether the user advertiser is the data subject to whom the special category data pertain;
• if not, to refuse the publication of the ad if the user advertiser cannot establish a valid legal basis; and
• to generally prevent ads containing sensitive data from being copied and unlawfully published on other websites.
Whilst the CJEU made it clear that operators of online marketplaces are under proactive obligations in terms of personal data, the ruling’s full implications remain difficult to ascertain.

AI.tldr: 欧盟法院在Russmedia案中裁定，在线市场平台运营商作为个人数据控制者，须对用户发布的广告承担主动审查义务，包括识别特殊类别数据、核实数据主体身份、拒绝违法发布以及防止敏感数据被复制传播。该判决引发了对GDPR原则与实践之间差距的激烈讨论。
AI.research_question: 在线市场平台运营商作为个人数据控制者，在用户发布广告涉及特殊类别数据时，应承担何种主动义务？
AI.motivation: Russmedia判决引发了类似Delfi v Estonia案后的激烈争论，暴露出GDPR数据保护原则与实践执行之间可能存在的鸿沟，亟需厘清平台运营商的义务边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: GDPR第9条关于特殊类别数据的保护框架；数据控制者的积极义务理论；平台责任与数据保护原则的交叉适用。
AI.method: 判例分析法：对CJEU在Case C-492/23案中的裁决进行文本解读与法律推理剖析。
AI.findings: 平台运营商须承担四项主动义务：(1)判断数据是否为GDPR第9条的特殊类别数据；(2)判断广告发布者是否为数据主体本人；(3)若非本人且无法提供合法依据，则拒绝发布；(4)一般性防止含敏感数据的广告被复制并非法发布到其他网站。
AI.theory_contributions: 将GDPR第9条的特殊类别数据保护义务从被动合规延伸至主动审查，明确了平台运营商在用户生成内容场景下的数据控制者责任边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线市场平台运营者提供了四项可操作的数据合规义务清单，但也引发了关于义务实际执行难度和成本的重要实务讨论。

title: Advertisers' Self-Competition
affiliations: VU University Amsterdam, George Washington University - School of Business, Goethe University Frankfurt  and Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: Advertisers' Self-Competition
detail.abstract: Advertisers in programmatic display markets can compete against themselves for the same ad impression. This competition can occur through overlapping campaigns or multiple supply paths. We study the equilibrium and welfare implications of self-competition in repeated ad auctions with budget constraints, where the supply side determines the extent of bid duplication, and the demand side decides its exposure to bid opportunities. Using a game-theoretic model, we show that duplication affects outcomes mainly through advertisers' budgeting and pacing decisions. Once budgets bind, additional duplication induces more aggressive pacing, leaving prices and advertiser surplus unchanged. We further show that self-competition may benefit advertisers because advertisers' valuations are heavy-tailed. Thus, additional bid opportunities increase the probability of rare, high-value draws, which can outweigh the additional price pressure from heightened competition. We test these predictions using 4.7 million bids from 250,000 auctions on a supply-side platform (SSP). Bids exhibit substantial upper-tail mass, consistent with heavy-tailed valuations. Using a locationscale model, we recover a proxy for idiosyncratic valuation shocks and use it for counterfactual simulations. In the within-advertiser analysis, the expected surplus increases with the number of independent bid opportunities. This effect is stronger under heavier-tailed valuation distributions. In the cross-advertiser analysis, private incentives to duplicate bids persist for a substantial share of advertisers. Our findings challenge the prevailing view of bid duplication and self-competition as inherently harmful and shed light on how budgets, pacing, and supply-chain structures shape advertisers' and publishers' incentives in fragmented information environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究程序化展示广告市场中广告主自我竞争（通过重叠广告活动或多条供应路径）的均衡与福利影响。研究发现，当预算约束生效时，重复竞价主要影响广告主的预算分配和投放节奏，而非价格水平；由于广告主估值呈重尾分布，自我竞争反而可能带来更多高价值机会，从而增加广告主剩余。
AI.research_question: 在程序化展示广告市场中，广告主自我竞争（通过重叠广告活动或多条供应路径进行重复竞价）对均衡结果和福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有观点普遍认为广告主自我竞争（bid duplication）本质上有害，但现实市场中这一现象广泛存在。本文试图从理论和实证角度重新审视自我竞争的福利效应，解释其为何可能对广告主有利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型：研究重复广告拍卖中预算约束下的自我竞争均衡；重尾分布理论：解释广告主估值分布特征如何影响自我竞争效应。
AI.method: 理论模型：构建博弈论模型分析供需双方策略；实证分析：使用来自供应侧平台（SSP）的25万次拍卖、470万次竞价数据；采用位置-尺度模型（location-scale model）恢复特质性估值冲击代理变量，进行反事实模拟。
AI.findings: （1）预算约束生效后，额外重复竞价会促使广告主更激进地调整投放节奏，但不会改变价格和广告主剩余；（2）由于广告主估值呈重尾分布，自我竞争可能增加广告主剩余——更多竞价机会提高了抽中罕见高价值机会的概率；（3）广告主内部层面，预期剩余随独立竞价机会数量增加而增加，且估值分布尾部越重，效应越强；（4）跨广告主分析显示，相当比例的广告主仍有重复竞价的私人激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"自我竞争和重复竞价天然有害"的主流观点；揭示了预算约束、投放节奏与供应链结构如何塑造广告主和发布商的激励；将重尾分布理论引入程序化广告竞价研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为广告主优化跨广告活动和多供应路径策略提供理论依据；为供应侧平台设计竞价复制策略提供指导；为理解程序化广告市场的效率与福利分配提供新视角。

title: Enhancing Business Analytics with Automated ETL Processes: A Power BI-Driven Data Warehouse Extension

detail.title: Enhancing Business Analytics with Automated ETL Processes: A Power BI-Driven Data Warehouse Extension
detail.abstract: Business analytics programs frequently adopt Power BI for rapid reporting while leaving extraction, transformation, loading, data quality, and metric standardization scattered across individual reports, spreadsheets, and ad hoc refresh procedures. The result is a familiar analytics paradox: dashboards are easy to publish, but trusted and current data remains difficult to prepare. This paper proposes a Power BI-driven data warehouse extension that relocates repeatable preparation logic into automated ETL and governed dimensional layers while preserving the agility of semantic models and self-service reporting. The architecture combines landing and staging zones, Dataflows Gen2, Fabric pipelines, warehouse facts and dimensions, incremental refresh policies, and governance controls into a layered pattern that can be adopted incrementally by organizations with existing Power BI estates. A deterministic workload model illustrates how full-refresh report designs repeatedly process historical rows, whereas incremental and event-driven ETL strategies reduce redundant row work while improving freshness and observability. The paper also identifies design tradeoffs involving Direct Lake, import, DirectQuery, metadata lineage, historical dimensions, data quality gates, and security enforcement. The main contribution is a practical reference architecture and implementation roadmap for turning Power BI from a report-centric analytics tool into the governed consumption layer of an automated warehouse extension.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Power BI的数据仓库扩展架构，将分散在报告和电子表格中的ETL、数据质量与指标标准化工作整合到自动化、分层的治理框架中，使Power BI从报表工具转变为受管控的数据消费层。
AI.research_question: 如何利用Power BI驱动数据仓库扩展，解决数据准备分散、可信度低、更新不及时的"分析悖论"？
AI.motivation: 当前商业分析项目广泛采用Power BI进行快速报表，但ETL、数据质量、指标标准化等数据准备工作仍分散在各处，导致报表易发布但可信数据难获取。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据仓库分层架构理论（落地区、暂存区）、ETL自动化、增量刷新策略、治理控制框架
AI.method: 提出架构设计方案，并通过确定性工作负载模型对比全量刷新与增量/事件驱动ETL策略的性能差异。
AI.findings: 全量刷新报告设计会重复处理历史数据行，而增量与事件驱动的ETL策略可减少冗余行处理、改善数据新鲜度与可观测性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Power BI从报表工具角色拓展为受管控的数据仓库消费层，提出可增量采纳的参考架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套实用的参考架构与实施路线图，帮助拥有Power BI的组织逐步构建自动化的数据仓库扩展，涵盖Direct Lake、Import、DirectQuery、元数据血缘、历史维度、数据质量门禁和安全控制等设计权衡。

title: Malicious Use of GenAI: Cybersecurity Implications for Organizations

detail.title: Malicious Use of GenAI: Cybersecurity Implications for Organizations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author(s) have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: This study did not receive any funding.

detail.abstract: Generative AI is a model that has the capability to generate text, images, and other content based on the training and subsequent inputs provided. This new technology has paved the way for significant advancements in technology. There has been a rise in crimes related to the abuse of GenAI, leading to a growing concern around the regulatory framework for the same. However, there is a dearth of literature around the policy implications of the same. This paper presents an overview of the dark side of GenAI, key cybersecurity challenges, and potential solutions for managing this technology. Some key malicious use cases, such as fake text, images, and videos, are discussed, along with Gen AI-based malicious code generation. Potential solutions are presented for these scenarios along with a discussion of SOAR implementation. The paper presents a regulatory framework and roadmap for a proactive approach toward mitigating the security challenges due to Gen AI.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了生成式AI的黑暗面、关键网络安全挑战及潜在解决方案，并提出监管框架与路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何应对生成式AI滥用所带来的网络安全挑战，并构建有效的监管框架？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI滥用引发的犯罪日益增多，但相关政策文献严重不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成式AI滥用模型；网络安全威胁分类；SOAR（安全编排、自动化和响应）框架。
AI.method: 文献综述与案例分析，讨论恶意用例（虚假文本/图像/视频、恶意代码生成）及SOAR实施方案。
AI.findings: 生成式AI可用于制造虚假内容与恶意代码；SOAR可辅助缓解部分威胁；需要前瞻性的监管框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了GenAI的恶意使用场景与网络安全挑战分类，弥补了政策研究领域的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的监管框架与路线图，并为实践者提供了SOAR等可操作的技术解决方案。

title: The Role of Education in Fostering Global Peace and Humanitarian Action

detail.title: The Role of Education in Fostering Global Peace and Humanitarian Action
detail.abstract: This research paper examines the transformative role of education in fostering global peace and humanitarian action. Drawing on cross-national indicators, peer-reviewed scholarship, and five real-world case studies-Rwanda, Colombia, Bosnia & Herzegovina, Sierra Leone, and Sri Lanka-the paper argues that education is both a structural determinant of peace and a strategic instrument for humanitarian response. Eight visualisations are presented covering literacy and conflict risk, global investment in education, programme-level outcomes, the competency mix of graduate programmes in peace and humanitarian management, and country-specific trajectories of reconciliation, ex-combatant reintegration, humanitarian-aid allocation, and inter-ethnic trust. The paper concludes that scaling investment in peace-oriented education-particularly through interdisciplinary masters and doctoral programmes such as those offered by the Swiss School of Business Research (SSBR)-is among the most cost-effective levers available to states, multilateral institutions, and civil society for preventing violence and rebuilding fractured societies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过跨国指标、学术文献及五个案例（卢旺达、哥伦比亚、波黑、塞拉利昂、斯里兰卡），论证教育是促进全球和平与人道主义行动的结构性决定因素和战略性工具，并强调投资和平导向型教育（尤其是SSBR提供的跨学科硕博项目）是预防暴力和重建社会最具成本效益的杠杆之一。
AI.research_question: 教育如何在全球范围内促进和平与人道主义行动？
AI.motivation: 探究教育作为和平结构性决定因素和人道主义战略工具的作用，为政策制定者提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育作为和平的结构性决定因素；教育作为人道主义响应的战略工具。
AI.method: 跨国指标分析、同行评审文献综述、五个真实世界案例研究（卢旺达、哥伦比亚、波黑、塞拉利昂、斯里兰卡）、八项可视化数据呈现。
AI.findings: 教育与冲突风险呈负相关；全球教育投资对和平建设具有积极影响；跨学科硕博项目（如SSBR）在培养和平与人道主义管理人才方面成效显著；教育在和解、前战斗人员重返社会、人道主义援助分配和族裔间信任等维度均发挥关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统论证了教育既是和平的结构性决定因素，也是人道主义响应的战略工具，拓展了和平教育与人道主义研究的理论交叉。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政府、多边机构和公民社会提供了量化证据，表明投资和平导向型教育（特别是跨学科硕博项目）是预防暴力和重建社会的成本效益最高的策略之一。

title: Signal-Level Observability Gaps in Web-Based Systems: An Observational Study

detail.title: Signal-Level Observability Gaps in Web-Based Systems: An Observational Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the preparation, analysis, or conclusions of this work. The research was conducted independently as part of the author's ongoing governance research activities.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, personal data collection, animal subjects, or experimental interventions. The analysis is based solely on publicly observable system behavior and conceptual synthesis of the existing academic literature. Accordingly, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conducted and self-funded by the author. No external funding was received from any public, private, commercial, or non-profit organization.

detail.abstract:
Modern web-based digital systems operate through a dense ecology of discrete signals—structured transmissions of intent, state, and identity information that traverse collection layers, processing pipelines, consent frameworks, and governance environments. Despite the centrality of these signals to compliance, accountability, and organizational decision-making, the structural conditions under which they become unobservable, ambiguous, or ungovernable have received limited systematic treatment in the academic literature.

This paper presents an observational study of signal-level observability gaps in multiple publicly observable web-based digital environments, drawing on non-invasive browser-level observation and synthesis of governance, audit, information systems, and digital accountability literature. The study identifies and analyzes five categories of structural gap—payload invisibility, consent-state decoupling, identity-state inconsistency, signal propagation failure, and definitional ambiguity—and proposes Governance Observability as a distinct governance construct, arguing that it is analytically separate from technical observability (the ability to log or transmit a signal).

The paper does not identify specific organizations, make legal determinations, or propose a resolution framework. Its contribution is to establish signal-layer observability as a legitimate and underexplored domain of governance inquiry, laying the conceptual groundwork for subsequent theoretical and empirical work, including the development of signal-layer governance frameworks (Jha, 2026).

AI.tldr: 本文通过观察多个公开可访问的Web数字环境，识别了信号层面的五种结构性可观测性缺口，并提出"治理可观测性"作为独立于技术可观测性的治理构念，为信号层治理研究奠定概念基础。
AI.research_question: 在基于Web的数字系统中，信号层面的结构性可观测性缺口有哪些类型？治理可观测性与技术可观测性在分析上是否可分离？
AI.motivation: 尽管数字信号对合规、问责和组织决策至关重要，但学术界对信号变得不可观测、模糊或不可治理的结构性条件缺乏系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合治理理论、审计理论、信息系统理论和数字问责文献，构建"治理可观测性"概念。
AI.method: 非侵入式浏览器层面观察，结合多领域文献综合。
AI.findings: 识别五种结构性缺口：载荷不可见性、同意状态解耦、身份状态不一致、信号传播失败、定义模糊性；提出"治理可观测性"是独立于"技术可观测性"的治理构念。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统界定信号层可观测性作为治理研究领域，将可观测性区分为技术维度与治理维度，为信号层治理框架（Jha, 2026）提供概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字合规、审计和问责实践提供分析框架，帮助识别和诊断信号层面的治理盲区，但不提供具体组织的法律判断或解决方案。

title: Impact of Flexible Delivery Time Presentation on Customer Ordering Behavior: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
affiliations: , University of Queensland, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information & Systems Management and University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration

detail.title: Impact of Flexible Delivery Time Presentation on Customer Ordering Behavior: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
detail.abstract: As lifestyles become increasingly fast-paced, more customers are gravitating toward online food delivery platforms for convenient meal options. With time efficiency at a premium, a critical yet underexplored platform design choice concerns how delivery time information is communicated. This paper examines how the presentation of delivery time-specifically, a flexible delivery time window versus a fixed delivery time point-shapes customer ordering behavior. Leveraging a large-scale natural experiment on a leading online food delivery platform in China and employing a difference-indifferences (DiD) approach, we find that customers presented with flexible delivery time windows increased their orders by 0.16 and their spending by 6.61 RMB per week, compared to those provided with exact delivery time points. To uncover the underlying mechanisms, we complement the field evidence with a series of online controlled experiments. The results reveal that, although flexible delivery windows reduce initial order intentions, they enhance customer satisfaction through two underlying mechanisms: an expectation disconfirmation pathway and an algorithm perception pathway. We further identify an important boundary condition in delivery window size, such that excessively wide windows increase perceived uncertainty and reduce customer satisfaction. Together, these findings offer actionable insights for food delivery platforms seeking to optimize information design, improve customer satisfaction, and increase repurchases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模自然实验和在线受控实验，研究了外卖平台中配送时间呈现方式（灵活时间窗口 vs. 固定时间点）对顾客下单行为的影响，发现灵活时间窗口虽降低初始下单意愿，但通过期望不一致和算法感知两条路径提升满意度，最终增加订单量和消费金额。
AI.research_question: 外卖平台上，配送时间的呈现方式（灵活时间窗口 vs. 固定时间点）如何影响顾客的下单行为和满意度？
AI.motivation: 随着生活节奏加快，顾客越来越依赖外卖平台，时间效率成为关键因素。然而，配送时间信息如何设计（灵活窗口 vs. 固定时间点）对顾客行为的影响尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望不一致理论（Expectation Disconfirmation）、算法感知（Algorithm Perception）
AI.method: 大规模自然实验（双重差分法）+ 系列在线受控实验
AI.findings: 灵活配送时间窗口使顾客每周订单量增加0.16单、消费增加6.61元；虽然降低初始下单意愿，但通过期望不一致和算法感知两条机制提升满意度；配送时间窗口过大时，感知不确定性增加，导致满意度下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了配送时间信息呈现方式影响顾客行为的心理机制（期望不一致与算法感知），拓展了信息呈现设计在平台经济中的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外卖平台优化配送时间信息设计提供 actionable insights，帮助提升顾客满意度和复购率。

title: War Emission Protocol - A Scope-W Framework for Measuring the Climate Cost of War

detail.title: War Emission Protocol - A Scope-W Framework for Measuring the Climate Cost of War

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. ENHANCE Institute is an independent structural audit body with no financial relationship to any government, multilateral institution, defense contractor, or climate finance intermediary referenced in this paper. The framework presented reflects the author's independent analytical work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a methodological and policy framework. It does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical research, or personal data collection. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently under ENHANCE Institute without financial support from any public or private funding body.

detail.abstract:
Armed conflict remains a structurally under-accounted driver of greenhouse gas emissions, ecosystem degradation, and climate-transition disruption. Although the international community has developed increasingly sophisticated systems for measuring emissions from energy, industry, agriculture, transport, and land use, no standardized framework exists for classifying and quantifying conflict-related emissions and climate-relevant destruction as a distinct category of climate accountability. 

This paper introduces the War Emission Protocol (WEP), a structural accounting framework for conflict-related climate damage. WEP proposes Scope-W as a parallel emissions and damage-accounting category operating alongside existing Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 inventories. The framework defines seven War Emission Components (WEC₁–WEC₇), covering direct combat emissions, military platform fuel use, forest and vegetation carbon loss, wetland and soil carbon disruption, biodiversity-function loss, infrastructure destruction and reconstruction emissions, and human and economic opportunity loss.

The paper distinguishes between two analytical layers. The first is a direct emissions and carbon-stock layer, covering emissions that can be expressed in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent through established physical or land-use accounting methods. The second is a climate-relevant damage valuation layer, covering biodiversity, human, economic, and institutional losses whose contribution to climate-transition capacity requires valuation rather than direct emissions accounting. Together, these layers form the Total War Emission Equivalent (TWEE) and support calculation of Total Compensation Value (TCV) for post-conflict restoration and climate reparations.
WEP does not determine legal responsibility for initiating armed conflict. Attribution of aggression remains the responsibility of competent international legal and political bodies, including the United Nations Security Council, the International Court of Justice, the International Criminal Court, and the United Nations General Assembly where applicable. WEP is designed to operate after such attribution, providing a standardized method for quantification, monitoring, reporting, verification, and compensation assessment.

By introducing Scope-W, this paper seeks to close a major gap in global climate governance: the absence of a formal method to account for the planetary cost of war. The framework does not treat war solely as a humanitarian or security failure. It treats war as a measurable climate-disruption event whose emissions, ecological losses, and transition damages should no longer remain external to the climate accountability system.
The paper further identifies human capital loss — concentrated among working-age men through the demographic structure of conflict mortality — as a causal antecedent of reconstruction emissions rather than a parallel and independent component. This relationship introduces the Reconstruction Capacity Constraint (RCC) as a methodological development priority for future iterations of the framework, and reframes the dominance of reconstruction emissions in Strict TWEE as a structural consequence of war rather than a methodological artifact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"战争排放议定书（WEP）"框架，引入"Scope-W"作为独立的战争相关排放与气候损害核算类别，包含七大战争排放组件（WEC₁–WEC₇），并区分直接排放层与气候相关损害估值层，旨在填补全球气候治理中战争排放缺乏标准化核算的空白。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个标准化的核算框架，将武装冲突相关的温室气体排放、生态系统破坏和气候转型中断纳入全球气候问责体系？
AI.motivation: 武装冲突仍是温室气体排放、生态系统退化和气候转型中断的结构性被忽视因素。国际社会虽有成熟的能源、工业等领域的排放测量体系，但缺乏将冲突相关排放和气候破坏作为独立问责类别的标准化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Scope-W核算框架；七大战争排放组件（WEC₁–WEC₇）；直接排放与碳存量层（以吨CO₂当量计量）；气候相关损害估值层（涵盖生物多样性、人类、经济、制度损失）；总战争排放当量（TWEE）；总补偿价值（TCV）；重建能力约束（RCC）。
AI.method: 提出结构性核算框架，通过分类定义七大战争排放组件（WEC₁–WEC₇），区分直接排放核算与损害估值两个分析层面，并引入总战争排放当量（TWEE）和总补偿价值（TCV）作为综合计量指标。
AI.findings: 战争排放可系统化为七个可测量组件；人类资本损失（集中于劳动年龄男性）是重建排放的原因前因而非平行独立组件；重建排放的规模是战争的结构性后果而非方法论产物；需要区分法律归责（由国际机构负责）与排放核算（WEP框架负责）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出Scope-W作为与Scope 1-3并行的战争排放核算类别；建立七大战争排放组件的分类学；提出重建能力约束（RCC）作为方法论发展重点；将人类资本损失重新定位为重建排放的因果前因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为冲突后恢复和气候赔偿提供标准化的量化、监测、报告、核查与补偿评估方法；填补全球气候治理中战争排放缺乏正式核算方法的重大空白；将战争重新定义为可测量的气候破坏事件。

title: Designing Cyber Threat Intelligence Artifacts Using Darknet Hacker Forums: A Systematic Literature Review & Systems Analysis Working Paper 2025
affiliations: Mississippi State University, Department of Computing and Cyber Security, Texas A&M, San Antonio, TX, USA and Montclair State University

detail.title: Designing Cyber Threat Intelligence Artifacts Using Darknet Hacker Forums: A Systematic Literature Review & Systems Analysis Working Paper 2025
detail.abstract: The need for organizations to combat cyberattacks is more urgent than ever. One emerging research approach that addresses this need builds upon leveraging darknet cybercriminal/hacker forums to design cyberthreat intelligence (CTI) solutions. To investigate this design strategy, we conducted a systematic literature review on the use of darknet hacker forums for designing CTI solutions. We provide a comprehensive synthesis of the literature. Further, we adopt a systems perspective and analyze the system development elements in the identified literature based on the input-process-output framework. Our synthesis offers a valuable resource for both researchers and practitioners, providing them with a detailed understanding of the current state of darknet hacker forums-based CTI development, the methodologies employed, and the diverse outcomes achieved. Our analysis comprised analyzing the input (data extracted from darknet hacker forums), process (methods/techniques used for processing/analyzing the data), and output (CTI solutions). In our analysis of the three components (i.e., input, process, and output), we identified heterogeneous and homogeneous elements within each; this served as the basis for categorizing the studies. By offering a structured overview of the field, this paper underscores the different darknet hacker forum-based CTI design approaches found in existing research and additionally suggests directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对暗网黑客论坛用于设计网络威胁情报（CTI）解决方案的相关文献进行系统综述，基于输入-过程-输出框架，系统梳理了该领域的研究现状、方法论和成果，并为未来研究提供了方向。
AI.research_question: 如何利用暗网黑客论坛来设计网络威胁情报（CTI）解决方案？现有文献在该领域的研究现状、方法论和成果如何？
AI.motivation: 组织对抗网络攻击的需求日益迫切，而利用暗网网络犯罪/黑客论坛设计CTI解决方案是一种新兴但尚未被系统梳理的研究路径，亟需一篇全面的文献综述来整合现有知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统视角下的输入-过程-输出（Input-Process-Output）框架，用于分析CTI解决方案开发中的系统要素。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述（Systematic Literature Review），对暗网黑客论坛用于CTI设计的相关文献进行全面检索、筛选和综合，并基于输入-过程-输出框架进行结构化分析。
AI.findings: 在输入（从暗网黑客论坛提取的数据）、过程（数据处理/分析方法与技术）和输出（CTI解决方案）三个维度中，均识别出同质性和异质性要素，并以此为基础对现有研究进行了分类；提供了该领域研究现状、方法论和多样化成果的全面综合。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过系统视角的输入-过程-输出框架，为暗网黑客论坛驱动的CTI设计提供了结构化的理论分析框架，揭示了该领域研究要素的异同和分类逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和从业者提供了暗网黑客论坛为基础的CTI开发的全面现状参考，包括不同设计方法、方法论选择及成果类型，并指出了未来研究方向。

title: DORA Compliance Readiness: A Comparative Architecture and Cost/Performance Analysis of AWS European Sovereign Cloud and Google Cloud Sovereign Solutions for EU Financial Institutions

detail.title: DORA Compliance Readiness: A Comparative Architecture and Cost/Performance Analysis of AWS European Sovereign Cloud and Google Cloud Sovereign Solutions for EU Financial Institutions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, data, or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The entry into force of the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) in January 2025, the subsequent designation of Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud EMEA as Critical ICT Third-Party Providers, and the January 2026 launch of the AWS European Sovereign Cloud have together created a regulatory and technical landscape that did not exist when most prior cloud sovereignty literature was written. This study extends an earlier comparative architecture analysis of Google Cloud Platform and AWS for financial services sovereignty by examining the two providers' dedicated sovereign offerings specifically: the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, operated as a single wholly-owned EU subsidiary, and Google Cloud's federated network of national sovereign partners. The two architectures are mapped onto the European Commission's Cloud Sovereignty Framework and its eight weighted Sovereignty Objectives. Galij, Pawlak and Grzyb benchmarked data-sovereignty tooling overhead on Google Cloud and Azure in 2024, then extended that same benchmark to standard AWS regions in a 2025 follow-up; this study treats their published baseline as the empirical foundation rather than re-running it, and instead develops a documentationbased estimate of the cost and performance overhead, the "sovereignty tax," of the providers' dedicated sovereign infrastructure relative to their standard regions, since neither AWS European Sovereign Cloud nor Google's sovereign partner infrastructure is currently reachable for hands-on benchmarking by an independent researcher. An independent replication of the published baseline and a direct measurement inside the sovereign partitions themselves are proposed as future work. The analysis finds that the two providers have converged on the same regulatory target through structurally opposite means: centralized single-entity ownership versus distributed multi-partner ownership, a contrast with direct implications for how financial institutions and regulators should reason about concentration risk under DORA.

AI.tldr: 本文对比分析了AWS欧洲主权云（单一全资子公司模式）和Google Cloud联邦式国家主权合作伙伴网络在DORA法规下的架构差异，基于文档估算了两者相对标准区域的"主权税"成本与性能开销，发现两种模式通过截然相反的结构实现了趋同的监管目标，对金融机构在DORA下评估集中度风险具有直接意义。
AI.research_question: 在DORA法规生效背景下，AWS欧洲主权云与Google Cloud主权合作伙伴网络在架构设计上如何对比？二者的"主权税"（成本与性能开销）有多高？
AI.motivation: DORA于2025年1月生效，AWS和Google Cloud被指定为关键ICT第三方服务提供商，AWS欧洲主权云于2026年1月上线——这一全新的监管与技术格局使得此前大部分云主权文献已经过时，亟需更新研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟委员会云主权框架及其八项加权主权目标；集中度风险理论（DORA语境下）。
AI.method: 比较架构分析法：将两家提供商的主权架构映射至欧盟云主权框架；基于文档估算（而非实际基准测试）"主权税"成本与性能开销；引用Galij、Pawlak和Grzyb的已有基准数据作为经验基础。
AI.findings: 两家供应商通过结构上截然相反的方式——集中式单一实体所有权 vs. 分布式多合作伙伴所有权——实现了趋同的监管目标；这一对比对金融机构和监管者在DORA下推理集中度风险有直接启示。
AI.theory_contributions: 更新了DORA时代的主权云架构比较研究；提出了"主权税"的估算框架；揭示了集中式与分布式主权架构在集中度风险上的理论差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构在DORA合规下选择云服务商提供了架构层面的决策参考；为监管机构评估关键ICT第三方服务提供商的集中度风险提供了分析工具；明确了未来独立复现基准测试和直接测量主权分区内性能的研究方向。

title: Assessing The Effectiveness Of Local Government Disaster Preparedness And Response Strategies: Uncovering Gaps In Coordination And Community Participation
affiliations: , University of Caloocan City, Graduate School and University of Caloocan City, Graduate School

detail.title: Assessing The Effectiveness Of Local Government Disaster Preparedness And Response Strategies: Uncovering Gaps In Coordination And Community Participation
detail.abstract: This study examined the local government's preparedness for and response to disasters, with a focus on identifying areas where coordination and community involvement were lacking. To evaluate the implementation of local disaster risk reduction and management (DRRM) systems at the community level, the research employed a qualitative documentary analysis approach, examining disaster-related policies, evaluation reports, and scholarly literature. Results indicate that although the majority of local government entities have set up DRRM structures in accordance with national regulations like RA10121, the degree of implementation is still uneven. Response efficiency is still impacted by coordination issues, especially when it comes to agency communication and role clarity. In the meantime, community involvement is frequently restricted to preparedness planning, post-disaster risk reduction, and relief. The study concludes that disaster resilience necessitates not only the presence of formal disaster management structures but also improved inter-agency coordination and ongoing community engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了地方政府在灾害准备和响应方面的表现，发现尽管大多数地方政府已按国家法规建立了灾害风险管理（DRRM）体系，但执行程度参差不齐，协调问题和社区参与不足仍是影响响应效率的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 地方政府在灾害准备与响应中的协调机制与社区参与存在哪些不足？
AI.motivation: 灾害应对中地方政府协调不力、社区参与有限的问题普遍存在，需要系统性地识别具体短板以提升灾害韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害风险管理（DRRM）框架；RA10121国家法规；社区参与理论；跨机构协调理论。
AI.method: 定性文献分析法，对灾害相关政策、评估报告和学术文献进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 1. 多数地方政府已按RA10121设立DRRM结构，但执行水平参差不齐；2. 协调问题（尤其是机构间沟通和角色明确性）影响响应效率；3. 社区参与多局限于备灾规划、灾后风险减轻和救济环节，覆盖范围有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了正式灾害管理结构之外，跨机构协调和持续社区参与对灾害韧性的关键作用，丰富了DRRM实施效果的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府改进灾害管理实践提供了具体方向：加强机构间协调机制、明确角色分工，并推动社区在灾害全周期中的持续参与。

title: Supply Chain & Infrastructure: Empirical Studies On How Regional Infrastructure Deficiencies Or Port Inefficiencies Impact Manufacturing And Export Diversification
affiliations: University of California

detail.title: Supply Chain & Infrastructure: Empirical Studies On How Regional Infrastructure Deficiencies Or Port Inefficiencies Impact Manufacturing And Export Diversification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I was not funded.
declarations.ethicsApproval: They volunteered to help me with information.
declarations.funderStatement: I sponsored maself.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the empirical linkages between regional infrastructure deficiencies, seaport inefficiencies, manufacturing performance, and export diversification across developing economies, with an emphasis on the Pan-African context. Developing countries face structural bottlenecks, including prolonged customs turnaround times, inadequate multi-modal transportation networks, and unreliable power grids, which combine to act as an implicit tax on domestic manufacturing inputs and final exports. Utilizing a gravity model framework augmented with structural logistics indicators, this study quantifies the elasticity of export diversification measured via the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) and the number of unique HS 6digit product codes relative to port dwell times and regional transport costs. The empirical results demonstrate that a 10% reduction in port clearance delays yields an estimated 3.4% increase in manufacturing output value-add and a 2.1% expansion in the export product space. Furthermore, the analysis indicates that port inefficiencies disproportionately harm complex, high-value-added manufacturing sectors, which are highly time-sensitive, thereby forcing developing economies to rely on primary commodity exports. Strategic frameworks for regional infrastructure integration, digital trade corridors, and public-private logistics collaborations are proposed to overcome these structural constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发展中国家（尤其是泛非洲地区）基础设施不足和港口效率低下如何制约制造业表现和出口多元化，发现港口清关时间减少10%可带来制造业增加值提升3.4%和出口产品空间扩大2.1%，且低效港口对高附加值制造业的伤害尤为严重。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家的区域基础设施缺陷和港口低效如何影响制造业绩效和出口多元化？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家面临结构性瓶颈（海关周转时间长、多式联运网络不足、电网不可靠），这些因素相当于对国内制造业投入和最终出口征收隐性税，亟需量化其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引力模型框架，结合结构性物流指标（港口滞港时间、区域运输成本）分析出口多元化（赫芬达尔指数、HS 6位码产品数量）。
AI.method: 采用增强型引力模型，利用港口滞港时间和区域运输成本等结构性物流指标，量化其与出口多元化的弹性关系。
AI.findings: 港口清关时间减少10%，制造业增加值增加3.4%，出口产品空间扩大2.1%；港口低效不对称地损害复杂、高附加值、时间敏感型制造业，迫使发展中国家依赖初级商品出口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将物流基础设施变量系统地纳入引力模型，量化了港口效率与制造业绩效、出口多元化之间的弹性关系，揭示了低效港口对高附加值制造业的差异化负面效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了区域基础设施一体化、数字贸易走廊、公私物流合作等战略框架，为发展中国家克服结构性约束提供了政策路径。

title:
The Veda-Consolidation Mechanism Poll Aggregation, Strategic Voting, and Electoral Forecasting in Latin American Two-Round Elections

 Evidence from Colombia 2022 and 2026

detail.title:
The Veda-Consolidation Mechanism Poll Aggregation, Strategic Voting, and Electoral Forecasting in Latin American Two-Round Elections

 Evidence from Colombia 2022 and 2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests, personal relationships, institutional affiliations, or political commitments that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the research design, analysis, interpretation, or conclusions of this study.

detail.abstract: Why do pre-election polls underestimate rising outsider candidates in Latin American two-round elections? This paper identifies and evaluates the veda-consolidation mechanism: strategic vote transfer toward the most viable opposition candidate during legally mandated polling blackouts. The mechanism can generate large candidate-level errors while leaving bloc-level electoral structure comparatively well characterized. Using a composite-weighted poll aggregation model, the study tests three hypotheses: composite weighting improves on simple averaging; bloc-level forecasts outperform individual-candidate forecasts under blackout-driven consolidation; and errors for the consolidating candidate are directionally consistent across polling firms. Evidence comes from Colombia's 2026 first round (bloc error: 0.36 percentage points; Espriella individual error: 18.4 points), a retrospective comparison on Colombia 2022 (composite MAE 3.4 pp vs. simple average 4.8 pp), and a pre-specified 2026 runoff forecast (Espriella projected at 53.46%; conservative P(wins)=91.4%; 90% CI [49.3%-57.6%]). A benchmark suite and leave-one-out robustness tests confirm results are robust to modeling choices. The framework is extended to 12 Latin American two-round systems with polling blackouts.

AI.tldr: 本研究识别并评估了拉丁美洲两轮选举中“选前民调封锁-选票整合机制”：在法定民调静默期内，选民将选战略性地转移给最具竞争力的反对派候选人，导致民调严重低估新兴局外候选人。通过复合加权民调聚合模型，研究在哥伦比亚2026年首轮选举中验证了这一机制，并扩展至12个拉美两轮选举制度国家。
AI.research_question: 为什么拉丁美洲两轮选举中的选前民调会系统性低估新兴的局外候选人？
AI.motivation: 拉美两轮选举制度中，民调常严重低估最终表现突出的局外候选人（如哥伦比亚2026年首轮选举中，Espriella个体民调误差高达18.4个百分点），而现有研究对这种系统性偏差的机制解释不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: “选前民调封锁-选票整合机制”（veda-consolidation mechanism）：在法定民调静默期（veda）内，选民出于策略性投票考虑，将选票转移给最具可行性的反对派候选人，导致单一候选人层面的民调出现巨大误差，但阵营层面的选举结构相对稳定。
AI.method: 复合加权民调聚合模型（composite-weighted poll aggregation model）；基准测试套件（benchmark suite）；留一法稳健性检验（leave-one-out robustness tests）；回顾性比较（哥伦比亚2022年选举）；前瞻性预测（2026年决选预测）。
AI.findings: 1) 复合加权模型优于简单平均（哥伦比亚2022年复合MAE 3.4个百分点 vs 简单平均4.8个百分点）；2) 在民调封锁驱动的选票整合下，阵营层面预测优于个人候选人层面预测（哥伦比亚2026年首轮阵营误差仅0.36个百分点，而Espriella个人误差达18.4个百分点）；3) 整合候选人的民调误差在不同民调机构之间方向一致；4) 稳健性检验证实结果可靠；5) 机制适用于12个拉美两轮选举制度国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别并提出“选前民调封锁-选票整合机制”，为拉美两轮选举中民调系统性低估局外候选人提供了理论解释，揭示了民调封锁期策略性投票行为对民调准确性的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民调聚合方法提供复合加权模型这一改进方案；为选举预测、竞选策略制定和民调解读提供方法论指导；帮助选举观察者和决策者理解民调在特定制度环境下的偏差来源。

title: Brief of Amici Curiae Patent Law Professors Paul R. Gugliuzza and Jacob S. Sherkow in Support of Neither Party (Hikma Pharma. USA Inc. v. Amarin Pharma, Inc.)
affiliations: , University of Illinois College of Law,  and

detail.title: Brief of Amici Curiae Patent Law Professors Paul R. Gugliuzza and Jacob S. Sherkow in Support of Neither Party (Hikma Pharma. USA Inc. v. Amarin Pharma, Inc.)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hikma Pharma. USA Inc. v. Amarin Pharma, Inc., 24-889 (Sup. Ct. Mar. 9, 2026)

detail.abstract: This brief advocates for the Supreme Court to clarify the limits of patent inducement liability in the pharmaceutical context. Recent Federal Circuit decisions—including GlaxoSmithKline v. Teva, United Therapeutics v. Liquidia, Vanda v. West-Ward, and the decision below—have expanded inducement doctrine by treating FDA-regulated drug labels and routine statements of generic equivalence as sufficient evidence of encouragement of infringement. This approach, which amici have described as “infringement by label,” departs from both the common-law foundations of inducement and this Court’s precedent requiring purposeful conduct intended to bring about infringement. Under established principles, inducement exists only when a party affirmatively encourages, recommends, or promotes infringing acts with the requisite intent. Generic manufacturers, however, generally do not draft their labels; federal law requires them to copy the labeling of the reference listed drug, and both brand and generic labels are heavily constrained by FDA regulation. Moreover, prescribing decisions are driven primarily by physicians rather than label text. By grounding liability in mandatory labeling language rather than voluntary efforts to influence prescribing behavior, the Federal Circuit has transformed inducement into a form of strict liability. The Court should reaffirm that inducement requires evidence of intentional, targeted conduct—not merely the contents of FDA-mandated labels.

AI.tldr: 本文主张最高法院应明确药品专利引诱侵权的界限，批评联邦巡回法院将FDA强制要求的药品标签内容视为诱导侵权的充分证据，这背离了引诱侵权需具备主观故意的传统原则，实质上将引诱侵权变成了严格责任。
AI.research_question: 在制药领域，专利引诱侵权的法律标准应如何界定？FDA强制要求的药品标签能否作为诱导侵权的充分证据？
AI.motivation: 联邦巡回法院在GlaxoSmithKline v. Teva等系列判决中扩大了引诱侵权原则，将FDA监管下的药品标签和仿制药等效性声明视为鼓励侵权的证据，这种"通过标签侵权"的做法偏离了普通法基础和最高法院先例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利引诱侵权的普通法基础：引诱侵权要求当事人以必要意图积极鼓励、推荐或促进侵权行为；联邦法律要求仿制药企复制原研药标签，且品牌药和仿制药标签均受FDA严格监管；处方决策主要由医生驱动而非标签文本。
AI.method: 法律分析与案例研究：分析GlaxoSmithKline v. Teva、United Therapeutics v. Liquidia、Vanda v. West-Ward等联邦巡回法院判决，对比传统引诱侵权原则与新兴的"标签侵权"路径。
AI.findings: 联邦巡回法院将FDA强制要求的标签内容作为引诱侵权的依据，实质上将引诱侵权转化为严格责任，而非基于自愿影响处方行为的有意行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了专利引诱侵权理论在制药领域的适用边界，重申引诱侵权必须基于故意的、有针对性的行为，而非FDA强制标签内容。
AI.practical_contributions: 为仿制药企提供法律确定性，避免因遵守FDA标签要求而承担专利侵权责任，保护仿制药市场的竞争环境。

title: Three Failures: Willingness to Pay, Willingness to Accept, and the Welfare Economics of Community Destruction

detail.title: Three Failures: Willingness to Pay, Willingness to Accept, and the Welfare Economics of Community Destruction
detail.abstract: The gap between willingness to pay (WTP) and willingness to accept (WTA) is conventionally treated in the welfare economics literature as having two independent sources: income and wealth effects within standard microeconomic theory, and the endowment effect from behavioral economics. This paper identifies a third source-lexicographic categorical commitments-and argues that when all three operate simultaneously, as they do in every significant community destruction event, the standard welfare measure is not merely biased but conceptually misapplied to a domain it cannot enter. The central claim is precise: the standard welfare measure fails the deindustrialized community at three independent and compounding levels-and calls the failure objective science. The first failure is the income and wealth effect: willingness to pay is bounded by budget constraints in ways that willingness to accept is not, systematically underweighting the welfare of the poor and those bearing losses. The second failure is the endowment effect: communities are multigenerational endowments whose loss triggers loss aversion at a scale that makes WTA substantially and predictably higher than any WTP measure captures. The third failure is the deepest: for residents whose community is lexicographically prior-not tradeable at any price, not in the domain of compensable goods-the WTA is not merely high but potentially infinite, placing it outside the domain of the welfare measure entirely. The continuity axiom required for utility representability, identified in prior LawQuant work as the hiding mechanism for Bentham's commensurability assumption, excludes this preference structure by definition. Autor, Dorn, and Hanson's China Shock research provides the primary empirical case study: the deindustrialized communities that bore the costs of trade liberalization were not undervalued by the standard welfare measure. They were invisible to it at three compounding LawQuant Working Paper-1 levels simultaneously.
