We show that the maximal strong solution of the resulting variational inequality is the unique admissible strong solution whose gradientconstrained free boundary, namely the binding boundary, is monotone increasing in calendar time. A verification argument then identifies this strong solution with the value of the stopper-singularcontroller game, and duality recovers the optimal retirement, consumption, leisure, and portfolio policies. The numerical analysis recovers the value function and optimal policies, and illustrates how labor supply flexibility affects consumption, portfolio choice, and retirement timing under borrowing constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限时间范围内存在借款约束、劳动供给弹性及不可逆提前退休选择下的最优消费与投资组合问题，利用对偶鞅方法将原问题转化为零和停时-奇异控制博弈，并通过变分不等式求解，数值分析展示了劳动供给弹性对消费、投资组合及退休时机的影响。
AI.research_question: 在借款约束下，劳动供给弹性如何影响个体的最优消费、投资组合选择以及不可逆提前退休决策？
AI.motivation: 传统生命周期模型通常假设劳动供给固定，但现实中个体可以调整工作强度并选择提前退休，且面临借款约束。本文旨在将劳动供给弹性与不可逆退休决策纳入统一的动态资产配置框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cobb-Douglas效用函数（消费与休闲的替代关系）、对偶鞅方法、零和停时-奇异控制博弈、带障碍与梯度约束的极值抛物变分不等式。
AI.method: 使用对偶鞅方法将原始问题转化为零和停时-奇异控制博弈；通过求解带梯度约束的变分不等式得到对偶值函数；利用验证定理恢复最优策略；数值分析展示最优策略。
AI.findings: 变分不等式的最大强解是唯一的可行强解，其梯度约束自由边界（即绑定边界）随时间单调递增；数值分析表明劳动供给弹性显著影响最优消费、投资组合及退休时机，特别是在借款约束下。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将劳动供给弹性与不可逆退休决策纳入有限时间范围的消费-投资组合问题；建立了含双约束（借款约束+非负财富约束）的停时-奇异控制博弈理论框架；证明了梯度约束自由边界的单调性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临借款约束的劳动者提供了关于退休时机、消费与投资组合的量化决策参考；揭示了劳动供给弹性在个人财务规划中不可忽视的作用。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/31
title: Geoeconomics and trade
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), Deutsche Bundesbank, European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research and Ifo Institute

detail.title: Geoeconomics and trade
detail.abstract: We study the role of geoeconomics in shaping globalisation and trade policy. We first review the evolution of world trade since the end of World War II, highlighting the drivers of globalisation and its economic consequences. We then synthesise recent research on geoeconomics, which analyses how countries use trade policy as a tool to pursue geopolitical objectives. Against this background, we argue that the gradual shift in geoeconomic power from the United States toward China since the 2000s has been driving a fragmentation in world trade along geopolitical lines. We provide conceptual policy recommendations for the European Union to navigate an environment characterised by intensifying geopolitical competition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究地缘经济学如何塑造全球化和贸易政策，回顾二战后世界贸易演变，分析各国如何将贸易政策作为地缘政治工具，并指出2000年以来美国向中国的地缘经济权力转移正导致世界贸易沿地缘政治线 fragmentation。最后为欧盟提供政策建议。
AI.research_question: 地缘经济学如何塑造全球化和贸易政策？特别是地缘经济权力转移如何导致世界贸易沿地缘政治线 fragmentation？
AI.motivation: 理解地缘经济因素在全球化进程和贸易政策制定中的作用，尤其是中美地缘经济权力转移对世界贸易格局的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘经济学理论：分析国家如何利用贸易政策作为追求地缘政治目标的工具。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析：回顾二战后世界贸易演变，综合最新地缘经济学研究，结合历史与现状进行分析。
AI.findings: 2000年代以来，地缘经济权力从美国向中国逐渐转移，导致世界贸易沿地缘政治线出现碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地缘经济学与贸易政策分析相结合，揭示了地缘经济权力转移与贸易碎片化之间的因果关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟在激烈地缘政治竞争环境下提供了概念性的政策建议，帮助其应对日益加剧的地缘政治竞争。

title: GBC for Graphical Models: the Dual Geometry of CEGs and MDMs
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: GBC for Graphical Models: the Dual Geometry of CEGs and MDMs

keywords: 62-08. Keywords And Phrases. Chain Event Graphs

detail.abstract: Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC) is a likelihood free, simulation driven inference engine. It writes a posterior as a transport map θ = H(τ, S(y)) that pushes base noise τ ∼ U(0, 1)d forward to the posterior, and it learns H from prior predictive draws with a deep quantile network, conditioning only on a summary statistic S(y). Its central open question is which statistic to use. We answer it for two of the most flexible graphical model classes: Chain Event Graphs (CEGs), for discrete processes that unfold asymmetrically, and Multiregression Dynamic Models (MDMs), for multivariate time series with a contemporaneous causal architecture. Both, we show, carry a single dually flat information geometry. A staged tree or CEG is a discrete log linear (toric) model whose atomic probabilities are monomials in the floret parameters, so its staging hypotheses are affine in the natural coordinates and cut out e flat submanifolds. An MDM is a system of conditional Gaussian dynamic linear models glued by a contemporaneous directed acyclic graph, so each conditional filter transports a Gaussian belief whose moments are the dual coordinates while the graph imposes m flat constraints. Our main structural result is that in both classes the minimal sufficient statistic is the mixture (expectation) coordinate of the dual geometry, namely stage pooled floret counts for a CEG and predictive moments for an MDM, and this is exactly the statistic on which GBC must condition; a noise outsourcing argument then shows that the conditional transport map exists and is fixed by that statistic. The geometry therefore selects the GBC summary rather than leaving it to taste. We prove the supporting results, give one GBC algorithm covering both classes with a maximum expected utility decision layer, and validate the method on a staged CEG against the exact Dirichlet posterior, on a two node MDM against exact Kalman filtering, and on a non conjugate logistic floret against a gold standard sampler. Two empirical studies show the method at scale: a hierarchical, non conjugate staged tree fitted to the Titanic data, and a stochastic volatility dynamic network of four European equity indices, on which the GBC ensemble transport filter recovers the latent volatility that the conjugate Kalman recursion cannot, while an amortized GBC map estimates the volatility hyperparameters of this non exponential family model from a geometry selected second order summary

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）中的核心开放问题——如何选择充分统计量——给出了几何答案。对于链事件图（CEG）和多变量回归动态模型（MDM）两类灵活图模型，证明它们共享单一的二元平坦信息几何，其中最小充分统计量恰好是几何中的混合（期望）坐标，GBC必须以此条件进行推理。算法在多个案例中验证了有效性，包括非共轭场景和大规模实证研究。
AI.research_question: 在生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）框架中，对于链事件图（CEG）和多变量回归动态模型（MDM）两类图模型，应该如何选择最优的总结统计量（summary statistic）？
AI.motivation: GBC是一种无似然、模拟驱动的推理引擎，其核心未解决问题是使用何种总结统计量。本文旨在利用信息几何理论，为CEG和MDM这两类灵活但结构迥异的图模型提供统计量选择的几何依据，从而终结这一选择的主观性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二元平坦信息几何（dually flat information geometry）：CEG是离散对数线性（toric）模型，其分期假设在自然坐标下是仿射的；MDM是由有向无环图连接的条件高斯动态线性模型系统，其条件滤波传输高斯信念，图结构施加平坦约束。两类模型均具有单一二元平坦几何结构。
AI.method: 理论证明：证明两类模型的最小充分统计量是二元几何中的混合（期望）坐标——CEG为阶段合并的花序计数，MDM为预测矩。基于噪声外包论证证明条件传输图存在且由该统计量唯一确定。算法：给出统一的GBC算法，包含最大期望效用决策层。验证：在配对CEG上对比精确狄利克雷后验，在两节点MDM上对比精确卡尔曼滤波，在非共轭逻辑斯蒂花序上对比黄金标准采样器。实证：泰坦尼克数据的分层非共轭配对树，以及四个欧洲股指的随机波动率动态网络。
AI.findings: 1. CEG和MDM均具有二元平坦信息几何结构。2. 最小充分统计量即几何中的混合坐标：CEG是阶段合并的花序计数，MDM是预测矩。3. GBC必须以此统计量作为条件。4. 统一的GBC算法在多个场景中有效，包括非共轭情形。5. 在随机波动率网络中，GBC集成传输滤波恢复了共轭卡尔曼递归无法恢复的潜在波动率，且摊销化GBC图从几何选择的二阶总结统计量中估计出了超参数。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 从信息几何角度解决了GBC中总结统计量选择这一核心开放问题。2. 建立了CEG和MDM两类重要图模型之间的几何统一性——两者均具有二元平坦信息几何。3. 证明了最小充分统计量与几何混合坐标的等价性，为GBC提供了理论基础。4. 将噪声外包论证引入GBC框架，证明了条件传输图的存在性和唯一性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了统一的GBC算法，覆盖CEG和MDM两类模型，包含决策层。2. 在非共轭场景中验证了方法的有效性。3. 在泰坦尼克数据上展示了大规模分层非共轭建模能力。4. 在金融随机波动率网络中，GBC方法解决了共轭卡尔曼滤波无法处理的问题，并能从几何选择的二阶总结统计量中估计非指数族模型的超参数。

title: Earnings-announcement Cadence Variance and the Cross-section of Forward Returns

detail.title: Earnings-announcement Cadence Variance and the Cross-section of Forward Returns

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationship with any organization or individual that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this study. The study uses publicly available data sources (Compustat fundamentals from S&P Global Market Intelligence and CRSP daily stock files from the Center for Research in Security Prices at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, accessed via Wharton Research Data Services) under standard academic licensing terms. No funding, consulting fees, equity stakes, or other compensation from any data vendor, investment firm, or financial intermediary has been received in connection with this work. The author has no current or prior affiliations with the firms whose data appear in the analysis. The signal studied is not deployed in any live trading mandate operated by the author or any affiliated party.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is an empirical analysis of publicly available U.S. equity-market data and corporate disclosure dates aggregated at the firm-quarter level (Compustat and CRSP). It does not involve human participants, animals, patient records, identifiable personal data, or any other category of data subject to institutional ethics review. No primary data collection from human subjects was conducted, and no consent procedure was therefore required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or sponsorship from any funding agency, commercial entity, or non-profit organization. Compute resources (a single workstation running Python with Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib; pandoc with xelatex for paper rendering) and data access (Compustat and CRSP via a Wharton Research Data Services subscription held by the author for academic use) were self-funded. No language-model spend was incurred for this study; the paper draft was authored deterministically without LLM assistance.

detail.abstract: I extend the cross-sectional channel between earnings-announcement timing and postannouncement returns documented by Bagnoli et al. (2002) from the first moment (the within-firm directional deviation of the announcement delay) to the second moment (the within-firm time-series variance of the delay). For each firm-quarter (𝑖, 𝑞), let Δ 𝑖,𝑞 denote the announcement delay, defined as the calendar-day difference between the firm's quarterly earnings-announcement date and its fiscal quarter-end. The signal of interest, 𝑉 𝑖,𝑡 , is the standard deviation of Δ 𝑖,𝑞 over the eight quarters ending at 𝑡. On a Russell 3000 panel of 620{,}290 firm-quarter observations spanning 1999-2024 from the Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) and Compustat, the long-short portfolio that goes long the lowest-quintile 𝑉 firms within the Fama-French 12-industry monthly cross-section and short the highest quintile is sign-correct in 12 of 12 in-sample cells and in 11 of 12 hold-out cells (2017-2024). Four of twelve cells survive a family-wise Bonferroni correction at the 5% level in-sample; zero of twelve do so on the eight-year hold-out. The equal-weighted composite of the four primary cells, vol-matched to the in-sample maximum-Sharpe tangent combination of the Fama and French (2015) five-factor and Carhart (1997) momentum factors (annualized volatility 3.9%), delivers a Newey-West HAC-corrected annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.01 in-sample and 0.82 on the hold-out net of a 20-basis-point monthly round-trip transaction cost, against the tangent benchmark's 1.05 and 1.01. The cadence-variance signal is mechanistically separated from post-earnings-announcement drift: replacing the next-trading-day forward-window start with a one-week delay strengthens rather than weakens the result in all four primary cells. The within-firm directional deviation signal proposed by Chambers and Penman (1984) fails the same battery on the same panel under both symmetric and asymmetric encodings, indicating that the within-firm-deviation channel has decayed post-publication while the variance channel survives. The contribution is methodological: a moment extension of an established anchor, a parallel failed replication of the nearest prior signal, and mechanism-separation evidence ruling out the most natural alternative explanation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了盈余公告延迟的波动性（方差信号）与公告后收益之间的关系，发现公司内部公告延迟的时间序列方差能预测未来收益，而传统的方向性偏差信号已失效。
AI.research_question: 盈余公告延迟的方差（而非均值偏离）是否能够预测公告后的截面收益，以及该信号是否独立于已知的盈余公告后漂移现象？
AI.motivation: Bagnoli等人(2002)发现公告延迟的方向性偏差可预测收益，但该信号可能在发表后衰减。作者将其从一阶矩拓展到二阶矩（方差），检验方差信号是否稳健且独立于其他已知异象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于盈余公告时机与信息不确定性/投资者注意力的理论，将公告延迟的方差视为信息不确定性或管理层策略性披露的代理变量，与市场异象（如PEAD）相关联。
AI.method: Russell 3000面板数据（1999-2024，620,290个公司-季度观测），计算每家公司滚动8个季度的公告延迟标准差作为信号V；采用Fama-French 12行业内的五分位数多空组合，进行样本内和样本外（2017-2024）检验，并进行Bonferroni多重比较校正；通过延迟窗口起点等机制分离检验排除PEAD解释。
AI.findings: 方差信号在12个行业单元中12个全部符号正确（样本内），样本外11/12正确；经Bonferroni校正后样本内4个显著，样本外0个显著；等权组合在扣除20bp交易成本后夏普比率样本内1.01、样本外0.82；方向性偏差信号在同样本中完全失效；方差信号与PEAD机制分离。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公告时机信号从一阶矩（方向性偏差）拓展到二阶矩（方差），为信息不确定性或策略性披露的定价效应提供了新证据；同时系统性地复制并否定了Chambers & Penman (1984)和Bagnoli等人(2002)的方向性信号在当前样本中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化投资提供了基于公告延迟方差的交易策略，样本外夏普比率约0.82，且与PEAD等常见异象正交；提醒实务者原有方向性信号可能已因市场效率提升而失效。

title: Sleepless Nights, Safer Roads? Night-time Air Alerts and Behavioural Risk Avoidance
affiliations: Kyiv School of Economics

detail.title: Sleepless Nights, Safer Roads? Night-time Air Alerts and Behavioural Risk Avoidance
detail.abstract: Do salient threats make people take more or less risk? I study this question using wartime air alerts in Ukraine, a recurring shock that is threatening, disruptive, and often occurs at night. Combining time-stamped alert records with daily administrative traffic-accident data from Lviv, I find that each additional hour of overnight alert exposure is associated with about 10 percent fewer next-day accidents. The decline is concentrated in afternoon and evening travel, weekends, central areas, and accident categories linked to risky driving, while fatigue-related accidents do not increase. These patterns are consistent with behavioural risk avoidance: after a salient threat, people appear to reduce or retime discretionary travel and drive more cautiously. Evidence from thirteen other Ukrainian cities suggests that this response is strongest where alerts are relatively rare and weaker where alerts are routine. Salient threats can therefore reduce risky behaviour, but the response appears to depend on continued salience.

AI.tldr: 本文利用乌克兰战争期间的空袭警报作为外生冲击，研究显著威胁对风险行为的影响。发现夜间警报暴露每增加一小时，次日交通事故减少约10%，且该效应集中在非必要出行和危险驾驶相关事故中，但疲劳相关事故未增加。行为风险规避是主要机制，且警报的频繁程度会调节这一效应。
AI.research_question: 显著威胁（salient threats）会使人们增加还是减少风险行为？
AI.motivation: 关于威胁感知与风险行为的关系，理论上存在两种对立的预测：威胁可能使人更加谨慎（风险规避），也可能使人因压力或分心而增加风险行为。现有实验室研究的结论不一，缺乏高外部效度的实地证据。乌克兰空袭警报提供了一个独特的外生、重复且具有显著威胁性的自然实验场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为风险规避理论：面对显著威胁时，个体通过减少非必要出行、重新安排出行时间、以及更谨慎驾驶来降低风险暴露。警报的"显著性"（salience）是关键调节变量——当威胁变得频繁和常规化时，其行为影响会减弱。
AI.method: 利用2022-2023年乌克兰利沃夫市的高频空袭警报数据（带时间戳）与每日行政交通事故数据合并，采用固定效应面板回归模型，估计夜间警报暴露时长对次日交通事故数量的因果效应。并在13个乌克兰其他城市进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 夜间警报每增加一小时，次日交通事故减少约10%。2. 效应集中在下午和晚间出行、周末、市中心区域，以及与危险驾驶相关的事故类型（超速、酒驾等）。3. 疲劳相关事故未增加（排除替代性解释）。4. 在警报相对罕见的城市效应更强，在警报已成常态的城市效应较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了显著威胁减少风险行为的高外部效度实地证据，调和了实验室研究中的矛盾结论。2. 揭示了"显著性"作为威胁感知与行为反应之间的关键调节机制——当威胁变得常规化时，行为调整效应递减。3. 区分了不同出行类型（必要vs.非必要）对威胁的不同敏感性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对危机管理和公共安全政策有启示：在突发威胁事件后，交通事故可能暂时减少而非增加，但此效应随时间衰减。2. 提醒政策制定者注意"警报疲劳"问题，频繁警报可能丧失行为引导效果。3. 为交通安全干预提供参考：通过增强威胁的"显著性"（如针对性警示信息）可能有效促进安全行为。

title: The Environment of Social Institutions: Measuring the Informational and Behavioural Infrastructure
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Environment of Social Institutions: Measuring the Informational and Behavioural Infrastructure
detail.abstract: Institutional analysis has long treated the informational environment as a neutral backdrop-something institutions exist "within" but do not shape. This article argues that the medium through which signals propagate is itself a constitutive feature of institutional life, and that prescriptive communications (norms) operate on a plane analytically distinct from the behavioral clusters (institutions) they are assumed to produce. Drawing on Shannon's information theory, Rapoport's systems subjectivism, and empirical research spanning algorithmic governance, cross-cultural communication, and regulatory compliance, the article constructs a fully specified conceptual architecture for the informational dimension of institutional analysis. It defines a signal's internal anatomy (source, carrier, form, timestamp), proposes four measurable field-level parameters (density, propagation speed, access asymmetry, entropy), and formalizes the norm as a meta-signal-an interpretative code that exists in the information field alongside ordinary descriptive signals. The measurable divergence between the normative layer (what agents are told they ought to do) and the behavioral layer (what they actually do) is formalized as institutional anomie, a diagnostic variable grounded in Durkheim's original formulation and rendered operationally precise through modern computational methods-including the Jensen-Shannon divergence and total variation distance. Each parameter and construct is illustrated with examples drawn from digital platforms, cross-cultural settings, and contemporary regulatory environments. The result is a framework that treats the information field not as a passive container but as an active, configurable dimension of institutional analysis-one that can be measured, compared, and experimentally manipulated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将信息场视为制度分析的核心维度，而非被动背景。通过香农信息论、系统主观主义等理论，构建了包含信号内部分解、四个场域参数（密度、传播速度、获取不对称性、熵），并将规范定义为"元信号"。规范层与行为层的可测量偏差被形式化为"制度失范"，可用计算方法量化。
AI.research_question: 信息环境如何成为制度生活的构成性特征？如何将制度分析的信息维度进行正式的概念化与可操作化测量？
AI.motivation: 传统制度分析将信息环境视为中性背景，忽视了信息传播媒介本身对制度构成的主动塑造作用；同时，规范性沟通（规范）与行为集群（制度）的分析层面常常被混淆，需要理论上的厘清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 香农信息论、Rapoport系统主观主义、涂尔干的失范理论；现代计算方法（Jensen-Shannon散度、总变差距离）
AI.method: 概念建构与形式化建模，结合算法治理、跨文化沟通、监管合规等领域的实证研究进行例证说明。
AI.findings: 定义了信号的内部解剖结构（信源、载体、形式、时间戳）；提出了四个可测量的场域参数（密度、传播速度、获取不对称性、熵）；将规范形式化为一种"元信号"；将规范层与行为层的偏差形式化为"制度失范"，并可用Jensen-Shannon散度等方法量化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息场从被动容器重新概念化为主动、可配置的制度分析维度；为规范与行为之间的张力提供了精确的测量框架；将涂尔干的失范概念与现代计算方法结合，赋予其操作性精确性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台、跨文化环境、监管环境中的制度分析提供了可测量、可比较、可实验操作的量化工具与概念资源。

title: Contaminated Capital: Brownfield Grants, Entrepreneurship, and Place-Based Redistribution
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Finance Area, Harbert College of Business, Auburn University and Yale School of Management

detail.title: Contaminated Capital: Brownfield Grants, Entrepreneurship, and Place-Based Redistribution
detail.abstract: We study whether environmental cleanup incentives operate as effective place-based redistribution by transforming contaminated land into productive capital for local entrepreneurs. We link the universe of grant applicants to the Environmental Protection Agency’s Brownfields Program with business credit records, firm outcomes, property tax parcels, mortgage activity, and rental market data. Exploiting discontinuities in cleanup grant scores via a stacked dynamic regression discontinuity design, as well as EPA funding expansions in 2018 and 2022, we find that cleanup grants increase local firm entry, survival, employment, and business credit access, with complementary effects on parcel liquidity and mortgage credit that suggest remediation improves the collateral value of formerly contaminated land. These effects are concentrated within three miles of remediated sites and persist after construction activity ends, suggesting that remediation does more than generate temporary cleanup demand. Treatment effects are strongest in places with more severe pre-existing contamination, industrial decline, and credit frictions, and the gains accrue primarily to local owners and entrepreneurs. Environmental remediation incentives therefore increase aggregate local growth while redistributing investment toward historically capital-starved places through flypaper effects, mitigating the misallocation problem traditionally associated with place-based subsidy programs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国环保署棕地清理补助是否通过将受污染土地转化为当地企业家的生产性资本，有效实现基于地方的经济再分配。利用评分断点回归设计和联邦资金扩张，发现清理补助增加了当地企业进入、生存、就业和信贷获取，效果集中在修复点3英里内，且在污染严重、工业衰退和信贷摩擦严重的地区最显著，说明环境修复激励通过“粘蝇纸效应”将投资重新分配到历史上资本匮乏的地区。
AI.research_question: 环境清理激励措施能否作为有效的基于地方的再分配政策，通过将受污染土地转化为当地企业家的生产性资本，促进地方经济增长？
AI.motivation: 传统基于地方的补贴计划存在资源错配问题，而环境清理政策是否能够通过改善土地资本价值、缓解信贷摩擦，实现更有效的资源再分配，是一个未被充分实证检验的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粘蝇纸效应（flypaper effects）、资源错配理论、地方再分配理论、土地资本化与信贷约束理论。
AI.method: 采用堆叠动态断点回归设计（stacked dynamic regression discontinuity design），利用EPA棕地清理补助评分中的不连续性，并结合2018年和2022年EPA资金扩张作为外生冲击。
AI.findings: （1）清理补助增加了当地企业进入、存活、就业和商业信贷获取；（2）对地块流动性和抵押信贷有互补效应，表明修复提高了受污染土地的抵押价值；（3）效果集中在修复点3英里内，并在建设活动结束后持续存在；（4）在污染严重、工业衰退和信贷摩擦严重的地区效果最强；（5）收益主要归当地所有者和企业家所有。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了环境清理政策作为地方再分配工具的作用机制——通过改善土地抵押价值缓解信贷约束，产生粘蝇纸效应，从而减轻传统地方补贴计划的资源错配问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为EPA棕地清理计划的政策效果提供了因果证据，表明环境修复不仅能改善环境质量，还能促进地方创业和经济增长，尤其有利于历史上资本匮乏的地区。

title: Financial stability considerations for monetary policy at the European Central Bank: conceptual framework and quantitative tools
affiliations: ECB -DG Monetary Policy, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), , Banque de France, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank, European Central Bank (ECB), , European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Macroprudential Policy and Financial Stability, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), , , European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), CEPR, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), Central Bank of Cyprus, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), , , European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), , European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Financial stability considerations for monetary policy at the European Central Bank: conceptual framework and quantitative tools
detail.abstract: The paper documents models used to analyse the interactions and trade-offs between price and financial stability at the European Central Bank. The paper describes a simple conceptual framework to think about the short- and medium-term trade-offs between price and financial stability. Short-term trade-offs arise whenever current inflationary pressure is high, but the financial system is experiencing stress. Medium-term trade-offs arise whenever current inflationary pressure is low, but risk is building up in the financial system. We document four main sets of models used to quantify trade-offs: time series models, balance sheet models, credit risk models and DSGE models with banking and financial frictions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了欧洲央行用于分析价格稳定与金融稳定之间互动与权衡的模型体系，提出了短期与中期权衡的概念框架，并详细介绍了四类核心量化模型。
AI.research_question: 欧洲央行如何通过模型分析和量化价格稳定与金融稳定之间的互动关系与权衡？
AI.motivation: 价格稳定与金融稳定之间存在复杂的权衡关系，但缺乏系统性的分析框架和量化工具来指导政策决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 短期权衡（通胀高企+金融系统承压）与中期权衡（通胀低迷+金融风险积累）的双重概念框架。
AI.method: 四类模型：时间序列模型、资产负债表模型、信用风险模型、含银行和金融摩擦的DSGE模型。
AI.findings: 区分了短期与中期两种权衡情境，并建立了对应的量化模型体系来支持欧洲央行的政策分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了价格稳定与金融稳定权衡的短期-中期二分法概念框架，丰富了货币政策与宏观审慎政策协调的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲央行及其他央行提供了可操作的分析工具集，有助于在实践中量化权衡、优化政策组合。

title: The Hidden Cost of Invisible Logistics: Quantifying Post-Harvest Losses Attributable to Transport Failure Among Smallholder Farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: Youth Opportunities Hub

detail.title: The Hidden Cost of Invisible Logistics: Quantifying Post-Harvest Losses Attributable to Transport Failure Among Smallholder Farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a co-founder of ToraLoad, a farm-to-market logistics platform operating in Zimbabwe that is referenced in this paper as a source of illustrative operational observations (Section 3.4). These operational observations are descriptive and preliminary; they have not been independently peer-reviewed or subjected to formal statistical analysis, and are presented as directional context rather than validated empirical findings. The author has a financial and professional interest in ToraLoad's continued growth and adoption, which readers should weigh when evaluating the paper's framing and conclusions, particularly its policy recommendations favoring digital transport-coordination interventions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a literature synthesis and does not involve human participants, patient data, primary survey collection, or any other research activity requiring institutional ethics approval. The operational observations referenced in Section 3.4 are descriptive, aggregate business metrics from ToraLoad's platform operations, not a study involving identifiable individuals, and were not collected as part of a formal research protocol.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. No grants, sponsorships, or third-party financial support were received in connection with this work. The author's affiliation with ToraLoad is disclosed separately under Declaration of Interest.

detail.abstract: Post-harvest loss (PHL) in Sub-Saharan Africa is routinely cited at 20 to 40 percent of perishable output, yet this aggregate figure obscures the relative weight of its causes and has driven two decades of investment toward on-farm storage while transport, the link connecting every other stage of the chain, has remained comparatively under-examined. This short communication disaggregates published PHL evidence by cause and supply-chain stage, drawing on national household surveys, Zimbabwean tomatochain diagnostics, and regional value-chain studies, to estimate the share of loss attributable specifically to transport failure. Across the reviewed evidence, transport-linked factors, including delayed pickup, vehicle unavailability, poor road quality, and improper in-transit handling, account for a substantial and frequently underestimated portion of physical and quality loss in perishable horticulture, in several cases rivalling or exceeding storage-related loss. Operational data from digital freight-matching platforms serving informal African produce markets corroborate the literature by showing that reductions in farmer waiting time for transport correspond with measurable reductions in reported spoilage. We argue that PHL reduction strategies that treat transport as exogenous infrastructure, rather than as a coordination failure amenable to digital intervention, will continue to under-deliver. Policy and investment should be rebalanced toward demand-responsive, technology-enabled transport coordination for last-mile produce movement.

AI.tldr: 本文指出撒哈拉以南非洲的生鲜农产品产后损失（PHL）常被笼统地报告为20%-40%，但这一数字掩盖了不同成因的相对重要性。过去二十年投资过度集中于农场储存，而运输环节（连接供应链各环节的关键）却被忽视。作者通过整合多项证据，揭示运输相关因素（延迟收货、车辆不可用、路况差、不当装卸）导致的损失被严重低估，在某些案例中甚至超过储存损失。文章主张应将产后损失视为"协调失灵"而非基础设施问题，并呼吁通过数字化货运匹配平台等技术手段重新平衡投资。
AI.research_question: 在撒哈拉以南非洲的生鲜农产品产后损失中，运输因素造成的损失占比有多大？为何该因素长期被低估？
AI.motivation: 尽管产后损失常被报告为20%-40%，但这一笼统数字掩盖了不同成因的相对权重。过去二十年投资过度聚焦于农场储存，而运输作为连接供应链各环节的关键链路却被忽视，导致减损策略效果不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产后损失的系统性归因框架、供应链阶段分析、协调失灵理论
AI.method: 综合多种证据来源：国家住户调查、津巴布韦番茄供应链诊断、区域价值链研究，以及来自数字化货运匹配平台的运营数据。
AI.findings: 运输相关因素（延迟收货、车辆不可用、路况差、不当装卸）导致的产后损失被严重低估，在多个案例中与储存损失相当甚至超过；数字化平台数据表明减少农户等待运输的时间可显著降低损耗。
AI.theory_contributions: 将运输因素从"外生基础设施"重新概念化为"可被数字技术干预的协调失灵"，修正了产后损失归因的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁政策与投资应从农场储存转向需求响应型、技术驱动的运输协调方案，特别是针对生鲜农产品最后一公里运输的数字化货运匹配平台。

title: Who Pays for Growth? Evidence from Data Centers and the Grid
affiliations: Sanford School of Public Policy, Duke University , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, North Carolina State University and North Carolina State University

detail.title: Who Pays for Growth? Evidence from Data Centers and the Grid

declarations.funderStatement: Zhenxuan Wang gratefully acknowledges funding support from the Institute for Humane Studies (grant no. IHS020420) for data purchase.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is driving rapid growth in electricity demand through the expansion of data centers. Meeting this demand requires complementary infrastructure investment, but who pays for that investment depends on the institutions that finance, regulate, and allocate its costs. We study this question by linking facility-level data on data center entry to utility-level data on retail electricity prices, infrastructure investment, operational outcomes, and regulatory rate case proceedings across the United States. Data center entry between 2010 and 2024 increases average retail electricity prices by 2.7%, with effects of 2.1% for residential customers, 2.8% for commercial customers, and 4.2% for industrial customers. These effects are concentrated among investor-owned utilities, where average retail prices rise by 5.6%, while effects are much smaller among publicly-owned utilities and absent among cooperatives. Price increases are also larger in states with deregulated electricity generation. To explain these patterns, we examine utility investment, operations, and rate case outcomes. Data center entry induces real infrastructure and operational responses, including construction work in progress, generation investment, transmission spending, and larger authorized rate bases. But pass-through depends on regulatory environment: vertically integrated utilities in regulated states appear to absorb load growth partly through improved utilization, while utilities in deregulated states exhibit more active cost recovery and greater exposure to system constraints. The results show that the incidence of infrastructure-intensive technological change depends not only on the technology itself, but also on the institutions governing complementary infrastructure investment and cost recovery.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过链接数据中心设施级数据与美国公用事业级数据，发现2010-2024年间数据中心进入导致零售电价平均上涨2.7%，其中投资者所有的公用事业公司电价上涨5.6%，而公有和合作制企业影响较小。价格上涨幅度受监管环境显著调节，揭示了基础设施密集型技术变革的成本分摊取决于制度安排。
AI.research_question: 人工智能驱动的数据中心扩张所带来的电力基础设施投资成本由谁承担？不同类型的电力公用事业机构和监管制度如何影响这一成本分摊？
AI.motivation: AI发展导致数据中心电力需求激增，但配套基础设施投资的成本分摊机制尚不明确。理解谁为这些投资"买单"对于能源政策、电力市场设计和AI可持续发展的治理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施投资与成本回收的制度经济学理论；电力公用事业监管制度（投资者所有 vs. 公有 vs. 合作制）对成本传递的影响；垂直整合型与放松管制型电力市场的差异。
AI.method: 将设施级数据中心进入数据与公用事业级零售电价、基础设施投资、运营结果及监管费率案件数据进行链接，采用面板数据回归分析，识别数据中心进入对各类用户电价的影响及其异质性。
AI.findings: 数据中心进入使平均零售电价上涨2.7%（居民2.1%、商业2.8%、工业4.2%）；投资者所有的公用事业公司电价上涨5.6%，显著高于公有和合作制企业；放松管制州的价格上涨更大；数据中心进入刺激了基础设施投资和运营响应，但成本传递程度取决于监管环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了基础设施密集型技术变革的成本分摊不仅取决于技术本身，更取决于治理互补性基础设施投资和成本回收的制度安排，将制度经济学视角引入AI与能源交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了数据中心扩张对电价异质性影响的实证证据；提示不同所有权结构和监管体制下的电力用户面临不同的成本分摊结果；为AI基础设施投资规划和电力市场监管改革提供参考。

title: Taxing Generative AI: Evidence from Chicago

detail.title: Taxing Generative AI: Evidence from Chicago
detail.abstract: I estimate three empirical objects using variation from a new tax on generative AI: passthrough, demand elasticity, and incidence across the income distribution. To my knowledge, none has been estimated in the consumer market for generative AI. Using transaction-level data from 97 million debit and credit cards, I first establish that a 9% tax induced a price increase of 8.06%, i.e. near full pass-through. Second, 13 months after the tax, ChatGPT subscriptions in Chicago were approximately 25.9% below a synthetic control, implying a demand elasticity of -3.2. Third, while ChatGPT subscribers are much richer than average, a tax on generative AI is not progressive as a share of income. The income gradient in subscriptions is not steep enough to offset the fact that the tax is a flat dollar amount. Finally, combining these estimates in a sufficient statistics formula, I find an optimal tax rate on ChatGPT far below Chicago's current rate of 15%.

AI.tldr: 本文利用芝加哥对生成式AI（ChatGPT）征收的新税数据，估计了价格传导率（近全传导，8.06%）、需求弹性（-3.2）以及税收负担在收入分配中的归宿。研究发现，该税并非累进税，且最优税率远低于现行15%。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI消费市场中，税收的价格传导、需求弹性及收入分配归宿如何？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI消费者市场中的税收经济学效应尚未被研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收归宿理论、需求弹性估计、最优税收的充分统计量公式。
AI.method: 利用9700万张借记卡和信用卡的交易数据，采用事件研究和合成控制法。
AI.findings: 1) 9%税率导致价格上升8.06%（近全传导）；2) 需求弹性为-3.2；3) 税收非累进；4) 最优税率远低于15%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次估计生成式AI消费者市场的税收传导、需求弹性和收入分配归宿。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生成式AI税收政策设计提供实证依据，指出现行税率过高且缺乏累进性。

title: Local Spillovers of Startup Innovation
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Hollo School of Real Estate, University of Richmond and University of Colorado at Boulder

detail.title: Local Spillovers of Startup Innovation
detail.abstract: When startups innovate, does the surrounding area prosper? Exploiting quasi-random assignment of patent examiners with varying leniency, we show that patent grants to startups increase nearby annualized real estate returns by 0.4 to 0.6 percentage points for residential properties and 0.5 to 0.9 percentage points for commercial properties and vacant land. Effects are largest for the first successful startup in an area and decline with additional successes. We also find that patent-granted startups spur nearby patenting, establishments, and jobs. Yet these real effects emerge only over the following decade, while real estate return premia appear immediately.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用专利审查员宽松程度的准随机分配，发现初创企业获得专利授权会显著提升周边地区房地产回报（住宅0.4-0.6个百分点，商业和空地0.5-0.9个百分点）。这种效应在区域内首家成功初创企业时最大，随后递减。专利授权还促进了周边地区的专利活动、企业设立和就业增长，但这些实体效应需要十年左右才显现，而房地产回报溢价则立即出现。
AI.research_question: 初创企业的创新活动（以专利授权衡量）如何影响周边地区的经济发展和房地产回报？
AI.motivation: 现有研究关于创新对地方经济的溢出效应存在争议，且面临内生性问题的挑战。本文利用专利审查员宽松程度这一准自然实验，旨在识别初创企业创新对周边地区经济活动的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于创新溢出效应理论、集聚经济和房地产资本化理论。创新活动通过知识溢出、就业创造和商业活动增加等渠道影响周边经济，这些效应可能资本化到房地产价格中。
AI.method: 采用准实验设计，利用专利审查员之间在授权宽松程度上的随机差异作为工具变量。分析初创企业获得专利后对周边房地产回报、专利活动、企业设立和就业的影响，并比较不同时间窗口下的效应差异。
AI.findings: (1) 初创企业获得专利使周边住宅房地产年化回报率提升0.4-0.6个百分点，商业和空地提升0.5-0.9个百分点；(2) 效应在区域内首家成功初创企业时最大，后续递减；(3) 专利授权还促进周边专利活动、企业设立和就业增长；(4) 实体经济活动效应需约十年显现，而房地产回报溢价立即出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创新地理溢出效应提供了新的因果证据，区分了房地产回报（预期渠道）和实体经济活动（实际溢出渠道）在时间上的不同反应模式，丰富了创新资本化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对区域经济发展政策、房地产投资策略和创新生态系统建设具有启示意义：支持初创企业创新可带来显著的地方经济收益，但效应存在边际递减；房地产市场的即时反应可作为创新经济效应的前瞻性指标。

title: Liberty Global and the Revival of Economic Substance
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School

detail.title: Liberty Global and the Revival of Economic Substance
detail.abstract: On April 21 the Tenth Circuit issued its longawaited opinion in Liberty Global. 1 By a 2-1 majority, the panel upheld the decision of the district court that a tax shelter used by Liberty Global had to be disregarded under the economic substance doctrine (ESD). This decision is the third victory of the government in ESD cases, following Patel and Otay. 2 But it is the most significant because it strikes a decisive blow against tax shelters built on a literal application of the statutory text but ignore Congress’s purpose in enacting that text. Patel established that the ESD can be relevant to tax shelter cases even if the shelters follow the text of the statute, and Otay held that a transaction that had a valid overall business purpose can still fail the ESD if that purpose did not require an elaborate tax-motivated structure. Liberty Global goes beyond these cases by holding that a tax shelter that complies with the text of the code can be disregarded because it deviates from Congress’s purpose in enacting that text. This is a welcome departure from the narrow textualism followed by the Tax Court in Varian.

AI.tldr: 第十巡回上诉法院在Liberty Global案中裁定，即使交易符合法规字面含义，只要偏离国会立法目的，仍可依据经济实质原则（ESD）否定其税务筹划效力。此判决是政府继Patel、Otay案后在ESD领域的第三次胜利，意义最为重大。
AI.research_question: 在税法解释中，当交易安排符合法条字面文本但与国会立法目的相悖时，法院应如何适用经济实质原则（ESD）进行裁判？
AI.motivation: 税务筹划方常常利用法条的字面文本构造避税安排，而传统文本主义路径（如税务法院在Varian案中的做法）可能纵容这类行为。本案旨在确立更严格的司法审查标准，防止纯粹的文字游戏侵蚀税制完整性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济实质原则（Economic Substance Doctrine, ESD）；目的解释论（Purposivism）与文本主义（Textualism）的对立；国会立法意图在税法解释中的权重。
AI.method: 案例分析法：梳理第十巡回上诉法院在Liberty Global案中的多数意见与少数意见，对比此前Patel案、Otay案及税务法院Varian案的裁判逻辑。
AI.findings: 1. ESD不仅可在交易不符合法条字面时适用，也可在交易虽符合字面但违背立法目的时适用；2. 即便整体业务目的真实，若交易结构不必要地复杂且为税务驱动，仍通不过ESD测试；3. 本案明确推翻了仅限于文本合规即可规避ESD的狭隘观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESD的适用范围从"文本合规性审查"拓展到"立法目的契合性审查"，丰富了税法解释中的目的论方法论，强化了司法对避税安排的实质审查权力。
AI.practical_contributions: 对税务筹划实务具有警示作用：仅依赖法条字面构造避税安排不再安全；为税务机关追征税款提供了更有力的法律依据；可能推动立法机关进一步完善反避税规则。

title: A Socioeconomic Analysis of AI Agents and the Restructuring of the Knowledge Labor Market

detail.title: A Socioeconomic Analysis of AI Agents and the Restructuring of the Knowledge Labor Market
detail.abstract: The widespread deployment of autonomous Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents is fundamentally reshaping the socioeconomic structure of knowledge-based industries. This paper examines the impact of these technologies on labor market dynamics, specifically focusing on the generational tension between senior and junior professionals. Utilizing a mixed-methods research design that combines macroeconomic technology adoption data with a qualitative analysis of vanguard industry case studies, we analyze how the automation of complex cognitive workflows alters the traditional talent pipeline. The findings reveal the emergence of "Synthetic Seniority": junior workers experience an immediate amplification of their operational output but lack the critical judgment required to audit subtle algorithmic failures. Concurrently, senior professionals who fail to adapt to the governance of multi-agent systems face accelerated obsolescence due to the economic non-viability of manual execution timelines. We conclude that AI agents do not generate a linear path toward technological unemployment; instead, they trigger a structural fragmentation of the labor market, shifting economic value away from technical execution and toward strategic human judgment and risk management. This shift underscores an urgent need to reconfigure corporate training frameworks and school-to-work transition models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI智能体对知识型行业劳动力市场的结构性影响，提出了"合成资历"概念，发现AI并未导致线性技术性失业，而是引发劳动力市场结构性碎片化，将经济价值从技术执行转向战略判断与风险管理。
AI.research_question: 自主AI智能体的广泛部署如何重塑知识型行业劳动力市场的代际张力，以及对资深与初级专业人士职业发展的差异化影响。
AI.motivation: AI智能体正在从根本上重塑知识型行业的社会经济结构，但对这一技术变革如何影响不同代际专业人士的职业生涯路径，尤其是"资深vs初级"之间的张力，缺乏系统性理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场代际张力理论、技术采纳与职业替代理论、"合成资历"概念框架、人力资本与战略判断理论。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：结合宏观经济技术采纳数据的定量分析，以及对前沿行业案例的定性研究。
AI.findings: （1）出现"合成资历"现象：初级工作者操作产出即时提升，但缺乏审计算法故障所需的批判性判断；（2）未能适应多智能体系统治理的资深专业人士面临加速淘汰；（3）AI并未导致线性技术性失业，而是引发劳动力市场结构性碎片化，价值从技术执行转向战略判断和风险管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"合成资历"（Synthetic Seniority）这一新概念，揭示了AI时代劳动力市场结构性碎片化而非线性失业的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业培训体系重构和学校到职场过渡模式改革提供紧迫的政策建议。

title: Assessing Sectoral Capacity for Wage Increase: A Multidimensional Analysis using CPS ASEC Data
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Assessing Sectoral Capacity for Wage Increase: A Multidimensional Analysis using CPS ASEC Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests in relation to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used publicly available secondary data (Current Population Survey, ASEC) and did not involve human subjects, patients, or participants. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: We analyze sectoral resilience for wage increase by constructing a multi-ratio composite index using the 2023 CPS ASEC data. The Unemployment Ratio measures labor market slack, with a 3% unemployment rate as a baseline. Sectors meeting this rate are assigned a ratio of 1, while sectors with higher or lower unemployment rates are adjusted proportionally. The Wage Ratio evaluates sectors based on their median wage levels, using the national median wage as a baseline, with adjustments made for sectors with above or below median wages. Further breakdowns include the Educational Wage Ratios and Regional Wage Ratios, which assess how education and regional differences influence wage dynamics across sectors and within the same sector. A formula that combines the Unemployment Ratio, the Educational Wage Ratio and the Regional Wage Ratio produces the multi-ratio composite index to assess sectoral resilience in a more granular fashion. Scores above 1 indicate a sector's capacity to manage wage increases effectively, while scores below 1 highlight potential pressure points that may require cost-saving measures. The multi-ratio composite index provides business leaders with valuable insights into strategic decision-making in a rapidly changing economic landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2023年CPS ASEC数据构建多比率综合指数，通过失业率、工资水平、教育及地区差异等多维度指标评估各行业应对工资上涨的韧性，得分高于1表示行业能有效管理工资增长，低于1则提示存在压力点。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个多维度综合指标来评估不同行业应对工资上涨的韧性？
AI.motivation: 在快速变化的经济环境下，企业领导者需要了解各行业对工资上涨的承受能力，以便做出更明智的战略决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于失业率基准（3%）、全国中位工资基准，结合教育工资比和地区工资比，构建多比率综合指数。
AI.method: 使用2023年CPS ASEC数据，构建失业率比率、工资比率、教育工资比率和地区工资比率，通过公式组合形成多比率综合指数。
AI.findings: 指数得分高于1的行业具备有效管理工资上涨的能力，得分低于1的行业则面临成本压力，需要采取节约措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个多维度、细粒度的行业韧性评估框架，将失业率、工资水平、教育和地区差异整合为单一综合指数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业领导者提供战略决策依据，帮助识别哪些行业在工资上涨时具有韧性，哪些行业需要成本控制措施。

title: Strengthening Disaster Risk Reduction In Metro Manila Educational Institutions: An Analysis Of Implementation Gaps
affiliations: , University of Caloocan City, Graduate School and University of Caloocan City, Graduate School

detail.title: Strengthening Disaster Risk Reduction In Metro Manila Educational Institutions: An Analysis Of Implementation Gaps
detail.abstract: This study analyzed the implementation gaps in disaster risk reduction (DRR) in educational institutions in Metro Manila. It focused on key areas such as resource allocation, capacity building, infrastructure, and preparedness measures, including drills and emergency kits. The study used a qualitative approach with elements of mixed methods, combining documentary analysis and data presented through reference tables. Data were collected from secondary sources such as government publications and related studies. Quantitative data from selected literature were summarized in tables to support the analysis. The findings showed that while schools demonstrate moderate preparedness, gaps still exist in resources, training, and infrastructure, affecting the overall effectiveness of DRR programs.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了马尼拉大都会教育机构在减灾方面的实施差距，发现学校虽有一定准备，但在资源、培训和基础设施方面仍存在不足。
AI.research_question: 马尼拉大都会教育机构在减灾（DRR）实施中存在哪些差距？
AI.motivation: 学校是灾害中的脆弱场所，了解DRR实施差距有助于提高安全性和应对能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 减灾（DRR）框架，涵盖资源分配、能力建设、基础设施和备灾措施。
AI.method: 定性方法为主，辅以混合方法要素；结合文献分析和参考表格；数据来源于政府出版物和相关研究的二手资料。
AI.findings: 学校表现出中等水平的备灾能力，但在资源、培训和基础设施方面仍存在差距，影响了DRR项目的整体有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证并补充了发展中国家学校DRR实施的理论框架，识别了关键差距维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育管理者提供了改进学校减灾工作的具体方向，如加强资源分配、培训及基础设施建设。

title: Women’s Rights in Afghanistan under Taliban rule- A Human Rights Perspective
affiliations: and Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr.Sagunthala R&D Insitute of Science & Technology

detail.title: Women’s Rights in Afghanistan under Taliban rule- A Human Rights Perspective
detail.abstract: The rights of women all around the globe from time immemorial has been in jeopardy more so in certain geographical regions than others and it has worsened with time. Women’s rights have been stolen, their freedom curtailed beyond reason, and their whole entity reduced to a mere animal existence. Though violations of rights and crimes against women are prevalent across the world, their intensity and prevalence have been excessive in certain states. The laws, rules and customs based on religion created by the powers that be, have all contributed to oppress women further. It is pertinent to mention that this study does not aim to diminish religion or is not against any specific religion or customs, but it only seeks to point out the shortcomings of the humans or leaders in interpreting and enforcing such norms for individual benefit and with the ulterior motive of suppressing one gender. This study is limited only to women rights in Afghanistan subsequent to the rule by the Taliban. It focuses on how the Taliban regime tends to affect millions of women’s rights and freedom in Afghanistan, and the role of international law in promoting women's rights. This study seeks to analyse the lives of women in Afghanistan before and after Taliban rule, and through that it sheds limelight on how women are treated even in the 21st century, as property of men and are suffering a worse fate than an animal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了塔利班统治对阿富汗妇女权利和自由的影响，并探讨了国际法在促进妇女权利方面的作用。研究发现，塔利班政权使阿富汗妇女的处境极度恶化，将其降格为"动物般的生存状态"。
AI.research_question: 塔利班统治如何影响阿富汗数百万妇女的权利与自由？国际法在促进阿富汗妇女权利中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内妇女权利长期受到侵犯，而在某些地区（如塔利班统治下的阿富汗）情况尤为严重。作者希望通过揭示阿富汗妇女在塔利班统治前后的生存状况，唤起国际社会对妇女权利危机的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 妇女权利理论；国际人权法框架；宗教与性别压迫的关系分析。
AI.method: 文献分析与比较研究——通过对比阿富汗妇女在塔利班统治前后的生活状况，分析塔利班政权对妇女权利的系统性剥夺。
AI.findings: 塔利班统治使阿富汗妇女沦为男性的财产，生存状况甚至不如动物；宗教和基于宗教的法律被权力集团曲解和滥用，成为压迫妇女的工具；国际法在保护阿富汗妇女权利方面存在不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了宗教教义与性别压迫之间的复杂关系，指出问题不在于宗教本身，而在于人类领导者出于私利对宗教的曲解和选择性执行。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁国际社会正视阿富汗妇女的生存困境，反思国际法在极端政权下保护妇女权利的有效性，促进对妇女权利更有效的国际干预机制。

title: Subjective Expectations and Inequalities in Human Capital Across the Early Life Course
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney (UTS) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Subjective Expectations and Inequalities in Human Capital Across the Early Life Course
detail.abstract: Inequalities in human capital emerge early in life and persist across both low-and high-income countries alike. Understanding the mechanisms behind these disparities is essential for designing effective policy responses. Heterogeneity in parental choice plays an important role. This article examines how subjective expectations data can be used to identify the sources of heterogeneity in parental choices and investments that shape children's human capital throughout the early life course. Drawing on evidence from multiple applications, I show how eliciting subjective expectations in surveys-and combining them with observed choices-can help disentangle the relative roles of preferences, beliefs, and constraints in shaping investment behavior. The findings reveal that the dominant mechanisms vary across contexts, highlighting the value of expectations data in guiding context-specific policy interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何利用主观期望数据识别影响儿童人力资本发展的父母选择异质性来源，揭示偏好、信念和约束在不同情境下的相对作用，为制定因地制宜的政策干预提供依据。
AI.research_question: 如何利用主观期望数据识别父母选择和投资中影响儿童人力资本形成的异质性来源？
AI.motivation: 人力资本不平等在生命早期就已出现并持续存在，理解其背后的机制对于设计有效的政策应对至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏好、信念与约束三因素框架，用于解释父母投资行为的异质性来源。
AI.method: 在调查中收集主观期望数据，并将其与观察到的实际选择相结合，以分离偏好、信念和约束的相对作用。
AI.findings: 主导机制在不同情境下存在差异，主观期望数据有助于识别具体情境下最关键的干预靶点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解父母投资异质性提供了方法论框架，将主观期望数据引入人力资本形成机制的研究中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供识别特定情境下最有效干预手段的工具，推动因地制宜的政策设计。

title: Copyright and AI Generated Output in the UK
affiliations: Universitat Pompeu Fabra - Department of Law and City University London, The City Law School

detail.title: Copyright and AI Generated Output in the UK

publicationDetails.detailsText: in R. Abbott and E. Rothman (eds.), Elgar Concise Encyclopedia of Artificial Intelligence and the Law, Edward Elgar, 2025, pp. 133–137.

detail.abstract: This entry explores the legal status of AI-generated creations under UK copyright law, highlighing challenges in recognizing AI as author. It examines the implications for traditional copyright frameworks, emphasizing the need for legislative adaptation and judicial interpretation to keep pace with AI's evolving role in creativity and ownership.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了英国版权法下AI生成作品的法律地位，指出将AI认定为作者面临的挑战，并分析了其对传统版权框架的影响，强调立法和司法需要适应AI在创造性和所有权方面不断演变的角色。
AI.research_question: 在英国版权法框架下，AI生成作品的法律地位如何？AI能否被认定为作者？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在创造性领域的广泛应用，传统版权法面临如何界定AI生成作品归属和作者身份的挑战，现有法律框架存在滞后性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 英国版权法传统理论、作者身份认定理论、创造性所有权理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究、比较法分析
AI.findings: AI生成作品在英国版权法下面临作者身份认定的困境；传统版权框架难以直接适用于AI创作；需要立法调整和司法解释来应对这一新兴挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了现有版权法理论在AI创作语境下的局限性，拓展了关于作者身份和创造性所有权的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国乃至其他普通法系国家的立法者和司法机构提供了关于AI版权制度改革的政策建议和参考方向。

title: The Analyst Information Frontier
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: The Analyst Information Frontier
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether professional analyst beliefs span public expected-return information. The analysis links a U.S. stock-month panel of non-IBES public characteristics from 1963 through 2024 to analyst forecasts, target prices, recommendations, earnings realizations, and returns. Public-signal themes predict later analyst updates, showing professional processing of public information. Public signals also forecast returns after conditioning on analyst beliefs: within analyst-belief groups, the high-minus-low public-signal spread averages about 1.5 percent per month, and matched comparisons preserve about 1.46 percent per month. The analyst-residual component of public information carries stronger return content than the analyst-spanned component. Reliability and conflict s tates i dentify b eliefs f ollowed b y corrections and different s ubsequent r eturns. T he e vidence s upports a n information-intermediation view of expected returns: analysts are informative professional processors, and public characteristics define a r eturn-relevant i nformation f rontier a round t heir beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨专业分析师的信念是否涵盖了公开预期收益信息。使用1963-2024年美国股票-月度面板数据，发现公开信号主题能预测分析师后续更新，且公开信号在控制分析师信念后仍能预测回报（高减低组合月均约1.5%）。分析师未涵盖的公开信息部分比已涵盖部分具有更强的回报预测能力。可靠性和冲突状态可识别随后被修正的信念及不同的后续回报。证据支持"信息中介"预期收益观：分析师是专业信息处理者，公开特征围绕分析师信念定义了与回报相关的信息前沿。
AI.research_question: 专业分析师对公开信息的信念是否完全反映了所有公开预期收益信息？公开信息中哪些成分未被分析师信念捕捉，且仍能预测未来回报？
AI.motivation: 已有研究分别关注分析师信念和公开信息对回报的预测能力，但较少深入探究两者之间的关系。本文旨在厘清分析师作为专业信息处理者，其信念在多大程度上覆盖了公开信息的回报预测内容，从而区分"信息中介"与"有效市场"两种理论视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息中介理论（information-intermediation view）：分析师是专业的公开信息处理者，但其信念并非完美覆盖所有公开信息，公开信息围绕分析师信念构成一个"回报相关信息前沿"。
AI.method: 使用1963-2024年美国股票-月度面板数据，结合非IBES公开特征与分析师预测、目标价、推荐、盈利实现及回报数据。通过分组分析（按分析师信念分组后检验公开信号的回报预测能力）和成分分解（分析师已涵盖 vs 未涵盖的公开信息成分）进行实证检验。
AI.findings: (1) 公开信号主题能预测分析师后续更新，表明分析师在处理公开信息。(2) 控制分析师信念后，公开信号仍能预测回报：高减低组合月均约1.5%，匹配比较约1.46%。(3) 分析师未涵盖的公开信息成分比已涵盖成分具有更强的回报预测能力。(4) 可靠性和冲突状态可识别随后被修正的信念及不同的后续回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 支持"信息中介"预期收益观，挑战了分析师信念完全反映所有公开信息的强有效市场观点。明确了分析师信念与公开信息之间的互补关系，提出了"信息前沿"概念，丰富了对资产定价中信息处理机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供了超越分析师信念的额外回报预测信号：分析师未充分关注的公开信息可用于构建超额收益策略。同时，可靠性和冲突状态可作为识别信念修正和预测回报变化的实用指标。

title: The Erosion of Labor-Based Comparative Advantage: Artificial Intelligence and Development Regime Transition
affiliations: The University of Manchester and University of Southampton

detail.title: The Erosion of Labor-Based Comparative Advantage: Artificial Intelligence and Development Regime Transition
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly recognized as a general-purpose technology capable of transforming productivity, innovation, and economic organization across a wide range of sectors. While existing research has primarily focused on the implications of AI for employment, wages, and productivity, its consequences for structural transformation and comparative advantage remain insufficiently understood. This paper develops a theoretical framework to examine how AI may reshape the traditional development mechanism that links labor abundance, low wages, manufacturing competitiveness, and industrialization. Building on the Lewis-Kuznets-Chenery tradition of structural transformation, the paper argues that AI progressively weakens the labor-cost channel that has historically enabled laborabundant economies to industrialize through manufacturing-led growth. A formal model is developed in which AI substitutes for labor in production while simultaneously reducing the responsiveness of competitiveness to wage differentials. Extending conventional structural transformation models, the framework incorporates task-level heterogeneity, sectoral variation in AI exposure, capability accumulation, endogenous AI adoption, and services-led development pathways. The analysis demonstrates that increasing AI adoption lowers manufacturing labor demand, diminishes the competitiveness value of low wages, weakens labor reallocation from agriculture to modern sectors, and slows the traditional structural transformation process. However, these effects are shown to be uneven across industries and tasks, depending on the extent to which production activities are susceptible to automation. The paper introduces the concepts of the erosion of laborbased comparative advantage, task-based comparative advantage, the structural transformation trap, and capability-based comparative advantage. The model predicts a transition from a labor-based development regime, in which competitiveness derives primarily from favourable factor endowments, to a capability-based development regime, in which competitiveness depends increasingly on technological capability, human capital, digital infrastructure, institutional quality, and the ability to adopt and complement AI technologies. Simulation analysis illustrates how AI progressively weakens the traditional relationship between wages, industrial expansion, and structural transformation while increasing the importance of capability accumulation. More broadly, the analysis suggests that AI may transform not only employment and production but also the fundamental mechanisms through which economic development occurs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建理论框架，论证人工智能正在削弱传统以劳动力成本为基础的比较优势，推动发展机制从"劳动力依赖型"向"能力依赖型"转型。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何重塑结构性转型和比较优势的传统发展机制？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注AI对就业、工资和生产率的影响，但对AI如何改变结构性转型和比较优势的理解尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Lewis-Kuznets-Chenery结构性转型传统，结合任务层面异质性、部门AI暴露差异、能力积累、内生AI采纳及服务业主导发展路径。
AI.method: 形式化模型构建与模拟分析。
AI.findings: AI采纳降低了制造业劳动力需求，削弱了低工资的竞争力价值，减缓了劳动从农业向现代部门再分配的传统结构性转型过程；这些效应在行业和任务层面存在异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"劳动力比较优势侵蚀""任务型比较优势""结构性转型陷阱""能力型比较优势"四个新概念；预测从劳动力依赖型发展体制向能力依赖型发展体制的转型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提供政策启示：应重视技术能力、人力资本、数字基础设施和制度质量的建设，以应对AI对传统工业化路径的冲击。

title: The Vestal of Pension-Age True Crime: Oksana Zabuzhko, Cultural Narcissism, and the Gender Industry of Ukrainian Literary Nationalism A Critical Polemic in Literary Studies, Psychoanalysis, and Cultural Theory
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Vestal of Pension-Age True Crime: Oksana Zabuzhko, Cultural Narcissism, and the Gender Industry of Ukrainian Literary Nationalism A Critical Polemic in Literary Studies, Psychoanalysis, and Cultural Theory
detail.abstract: There is something profoundly symptomatic — in the strict clinical sense of that word — about the scene that opens our inquiry. A Ukrainian writer of significant reputation, Oksana Zabuzhko, opens her Facebook feed at some indeterminate hour of the wartime morning, and, before she can register whether Crimea has become an island or what new territory in Russia is ablaze, she is assaulted — assaulted, mark you, not merely bothered — by discussion of a television personality who confessed to childhood cruelty toward animals. What follows is not a paragraph, or even a measured essay; what follows is a twelve-hundred-word Facebook performance, an act of prophetic lamentation over "the loss of cultural code," in which the tortured sparrows of nineteenth-century Ukrainian peasant literature are conscripted into the war of public morality, with Dostoevsky (Russian) condemned in the dock and Panas Myrnyi (Ukrainian) crowned in absentia. The audience applauds with 7,900 emoji-laden reactions. The prophet has delivered. The cultural code has been invoked.

AI.tldr: 本文以乌克兰作家奥克萨娜·扎布日科在战时社交媒体上的一场文化表演为切入点，分析当代公共道德辩论中"文化密码"的调用机制，揭示其作为症状性现象的深层含义。
AI.research_question: 战时社交媒体中的"文化密码"调用如何成为一种症状性现象？这种公共道德表演背后反映了怎样的文化逻辑与历史张力？
AI.motivation: 作者观察到，在战争背景下，乌克兰社交媒体上出现了一种以"文化密码"为名义的公共道德审判现象——公众人物过去的行为（如童年虐待动物）被纳入文学传统与民族叙事的框架中讨论。这种看似偏离战事的讨论，实际上具有深刻的症状意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 症状性阅读（临床意义上的"症状"概念）、文化密码理论、公共道德表演理论、文学民族主义、社交媒体情感经济
AI.method: 以扎布日科的Facebook帖子为个案，进行文本细读与话语分析，结合乌克兰文学传统（十九世纪农民文学、陀思妥耶夫斯基与帕纳斯·梅尔内的对比）进行历史脉络分析。
AI.findings: 1. "文化密码"的调用是一种高度修辞化的公共表演，而非真正的文化讨论。2. 这种表演将文学传统（乌克兰 vs 俄罗斯）武器化，用于当下的民族身份建构。3. 社交媒体的情感经济（7900个表情符号反应）驱动了这种症状性表达。4. 战时语境下，这种看似偏离主题的道德讨论实际上是集体焦虑的置换与宣泄。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"症状"概念从临床精神分析扩展至文化批判领域；提出"文化密码调用"作为一种仪式性公共表演的分析框架；揭示文学民族主义在社交媒体时代的转变形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解战时社会中集体焦虑如何通过文化叙事被置换和表达；为分析社交媒体中的民族主义话语与道德表演提供分析工具；提醒关注"文化密码"话语背后的政治性与表演性。

title: False Confidence in Machine-Learning Asset Pricing
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: False Confidence in Machine-Learning Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: Purpose: This paper studies when machine-learning return forecasts are calibrated on average yet overconfident in the states where portfolios take risk. Design/methodology/approach: The analysis applies conformalized quantile forecasts to the Chen-Zimmermann/OpenAP panel of 212 monthly stock characteristics in annual out-of-sample tests from 1982 through 2023. Findings: Ninety percent conformal intervals achieve near-marginal coverage, while highidiosyncratic-volatility and market-regime cells remain undercovered. A false-confidence score, defined as directional forecast confidence scaled by the positive undercoverage gap of the calibration group, predicts future forecast failure and produces a LinearQR conformal-FC signal with a 1.527 Sharpe ratio and 12.2 percent FF5+UMD alpha. Originality: The paper connects conformal prediction, conditional forecast reliability, and assetpricing portfolio performance by showing that a model's own calibration history is an economically priced state variable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现机器学习收益预测在平均意义上校准良好，但在投资组合承担风险的状态下过度自信。通过将共形分位数预测应用于212个月度股票特征的面板数据，发现90%共形区间接近边际覆盖，但高特质波动率和市场制度区间覆盖不足。定义的虚假置信度得分能预测未来预测失败，并产生夏普比率1.527、FF5+UMD alpha为12.2%的LinearQR共形-FC信号。
AI.research_question: 机器学习收益预测在平均校准良好时，是否在投资组合承担风险的状态下表现出过度自信？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少关注预测模型在不同市场状态下的条件可靠性，尤其是投资组合主动承担风险的极端状态下，模型预测的校准性可能系统性恶化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共形预测理论、条件预测可靠性、资产定价中的状态变量理论
AI.method: 使用共形化分位数预测方法，基于Chen-Zimmermann/OpenAP面板数据中212个月度股票特征，进行1982-2023年年度样本外测试。
AI.findings: 1) 90%共形区间接近边际覆盖，但高特质波动率和市场制度区间覆盖不足；2) 虚假置信度得分（方向性预测置信度乘以校准组的正覆盖不足缺口）能预测未来预测失败；3) LinearQR共形-FC信号夏普比率1.527，FF5+UMD alpha 12.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 连接了共形预测、条件预测可靠性和资产定价组合绩效，证明模型自身的校准历史是一个经济定价的状态变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出虚假置信度得分作为预测失败的前瞻性指标；开发了具有优异风险调整后收益的投资信号（LinearQR共形-FC）。

title: Vertical Mergers, Double Marginalization, and Foreclosure
affiliations: University of Miami Herbert Business School and University of Florida

detail.title: Vertical Mergers, Double Marginalization, and Foreclosure
detail.abstract: We analyze vertical mergers in markets where both the upstream and downstream sectors are characterized by a dominant firm and a competitive fringe. We show that adding a competitive fringe at each stage-while preserving the successive monopoly structure of Spengler (1950)-is sufficient to generate the full range of anticompetitive mechanisms identified in the post-Chicago literature. The premerger equilibrium exhibits double marginalization arising from the sequential exercise of market power. Elimination of double marginalization provides an efficiency rationale for vertical integration. The merger creates incentives for input foreclosure, customer foreclosure, and competitive fringe exit. We characterize five post-merger equilibria and show that the downstream fringe may exit the market without any active foreclosure conduct, as a consequence of the efficiency-driven price reduction of the integrated firm. Implications for antitrust policy under Section 7 of the Clayton Act are derived. The EDM efficiency defense and the nonpredatory exit harm are driven by the same parameter, creating an inherent tension in vertical merger review.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了上下游均存在主导企业与竞争性边缘的纵向合并，发现仅在各阶段引入竞争性边缘（保留连续垄断结构）就足以产生后芝加哥文献识别的全部反竞争机制。双重边际化消除提供效率理由，但合并同时创造投入封锁、客户封锁和边缘企业退出激励。研究刻画了五种合并后均衡，发现下游边缘企业可能因合并企业效率驱动的降价而退出市场（无需主动排挤行为）。EDM效率抗辩与非掠夺性退出损害由同一参数驱动，纵向合并审查存在内在紧张关系。
AI.research_question: 在上下游均存在主导企业与竞争性边缘的市场中，纵向合并会产生怎样的竞争效应？双重边际化消除的效率理由与反竞争效应（投入封锁、客户封锁、边缘企业退出）之间存在何种关系？
AI.motivation: 后芝加哥文献识别了多种纵向合并的反竞争机制，但这些机制通常需要不同模型假设。本文试图证明，只需在Spengler（1950）连续垄断模型基础上引入竞争性边缘，就能统一产生全部反竞争效应，从而为纵向合并反垄断审查提供统一分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Spengler（1950）连续垄断模型；竞争性边缘理论；后芝加哥纵向合并理论（投入封锁、客户封锁、排挤效应）
AI.method: 博弈论模型分析，刻画上下游各存在一家主导企业与竞争性边缘的市场结构，分析合并前后的均衡结果，比较福利效应。
AI.findings: （1）合并前存在双重边际化；（2）消除双重边际化提供了效率理由；（3）合并创造投入封锁、客户封锁和边缘企业退出激励；（4）五种合并后均衡被刻画；（5）下游边缘企业可能在没有主动排挤行为的情况下因效率驱动的降价而退出市场；（6）EDM效率抗辩与非掠夺性退出损害由同一参数驱动，纵向合并审查存在内在紧张关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明在保留Spengler连续垄断结构基础上仅增加竞争性边缘，即可统一产生后芝加哥文献识别的全部反竞争机制（投入封锁、客户封锁、排挤效应），揭示了效率驱动降价本身可导致边缘企业退出（非掠夺性退出），为纵向合并理论提供了更简洁的统一框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为《克莱顿法案》第7条下的纵向合并反垄断审查提供了政策启示：EDM效率抗辩与非掠夺性退出损害由同一参数驱动，审查机构需平衡效率收益与非排挤性竞争损害之间的内在张力。

title: When Do Anomalies Deserve Capital? Macro-Regime Memory and Dynamic Cross-Sectional Factor Allocation
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: When Do Anomalies Deserve Capital? Macro-Regime Memory and Dynamic Cross-Sectional Factor Allocation
detail.abstract: This paper studies when characteristic-based return predictors deserve capital. A broad anomaly panel is organized into economic families, and a macro-regime memory allocator assigns capital across those families under an annual walk-forward protocol. The lead allocation rule earns 2.13 percent per month, with a Newey-West t-statistic of 9.21 and an annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.51. The same family allocation structure improves the full 212-signal hierarchy by 0.0197 monthly information-coefficient points relative to static aggregation, with a t-statistic of 6.25. The model's answer is concentrated: Continuation and Valuation absorb most capital and account for nearly all allocation performance, while the other families operate as state-contingent exposures. The sharpest mechanism is Liquidity/Limits by market trend. The Liquidity/Limits family earns 1.41 percent per month in low-trend states and reverses to-1.79 percent in high-trend states, with the low-minus-high premium strongest outside the deepestcapacity stocks. The findings show that the economic value of anomalies is not fixed characteristic by characteristic; it is state dependent, organized by anomaly family, and shaped by macro conditions and arbitrage capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于特征的回报预测因子何时具有投资价值。通过构建宏观状态记忆分配器，将212个异象按经济类别分组，发现延续与估值类因子吸收了大部分资本，且流动性/限制类因子在不同市场趋势下表现出截然相反的收益特征，表明异象的经济价值具有状态依赖性。
AI.research_question: 基于特征的回报预测因子在什么市场状态下才真正具有投资价值？如何动态分配资本以获取最大收益？
AI.motivation: 传统研究将异象视为独立的、静态的预测信号，但忽略了其经济价值随宏观条件和套利能力而变化的状态依赖性。本文旨在建立一个动态分配框架，揭示异象的家族结构和状态转换机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观状态依赖理论、套利限制理论、异象家族分类框架、记忆分配机制
AI.method: 构建包含212个异象的广义面板，按经济类别归入异象家族；采用宏观状态记忆分配器在年度滚动协议下跨家族配置资本；使用Newey-West调整的t统计量和信息系数进行评估。
AI.findings: (1) 领先分配规则月收益2.13%，t统计量9.21，年化夏普比率1.51；(2) 家族分配结构使全信号层次的信息系数提升0.0197（t=6.25）；(3) 资本高度集中于延续与估值家族；(4) 流动性/限制家族在市场低趋势月收益1.41%，高趋势月收益-1.79%，且该差异在非深度流动性股票中最为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出异象经济价值具有状态依赖性的理论视角，证明异象价值并非按单个特征固定不变，而是由异象家族、宏观条件和套利能力共同塑造。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产管理者提供了基于宏观状态动态配置异象因子的定量框架；揭示了流动性/限制类因子在市场趋势转换时的择时价值。

reference: 102 IND. L. J. (forthcoming)
title: Affordable Care Act Retrenchment
affiliations: University of Miami - School of Law

detail.title: Affordable Care Act Retrenchment

declarations.ethicsApproval: The IRB determined this study meets the criteria for an exemption as described in Federal Regulation 45 CFR 46.104.

detail.abstract: The "One Big Beautiful Bill Act" (OBBBA) is poised to make the largest cuts in federal support for health insurance coverage in United States history. Yet this law is both poorly understood and rife with uncertainty. This Article tells the story of how the OBBBA will undermine the 2010 Affordable Care Act and reduce access to health care, how Congressional Republicans enacted the law, how state officials are struggling to implement the law, and what the law means for the future of the safety net. It draws on a series of in-depth interviews with 34 state government officials, health care nonprofit officials, for-profit lobbyists, representatives of health care industry groups, and other health care experts. It explains how the OBBBA will impose a dizzying array of new administrative and financial burdens on enrollees in Medicaid and the ACA Marketplaces, curtail health insurance coverage for legal immigrants, and shift the burden of funding the Medicaid program from the federal government to the states. It outlines the different legislative strategies and factors that led to the enactment of the law, which defies the conventional wisdom that social programs are nearly impossible to dismantle. It finds that state policymakers, who are charged with implementing many of the provisions in the OBBBA, are pessimistic about their ability to mitigate coverage losses and face various constraints in doing so. And it finds that, although there remains significant uncertainty as to whether the changes wrought by the OBBBA will endure or be scaled back in the long run, the law is likely to have fiscal ripple effects at the state and local levels that will lead to further cuts to Medicaid.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对34位州政府官员、医疗非营利组织官员、营利性游说者、医疗行业代表及其他专家的深度访谈，分析了"一个伟大美丽的法案"（OBBBA）如何大幅削减联邦医疗资助、破坏《平价医疗法案》、增加管理负担、削减合法移民保险、将Medicaid资金压力转嫁各州，并指出州政策制定者对减少覆盖损失持悲观态度，该法案还将产生财政涟漪效应，导致Medicaid进一步削减。
AI.research_question: OBBBA如何影响美国医疗保健覆盖体系？该法案是如何被通过的？各州如何实施？对未来安全网意味着什么？
AI.motivation: OBBBA将成为美国历史上对联邦医疗保险资助的最大削减，但人们对这部法律知之甚少且充满不确定性，因此需要系统分析其影响、立法过程、实施挑战及未来意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统观点认为社会项目几乎不可能被 dismantle，但OBBBA的通过挑战了这一常规智慧。本文基于政策反馈理论、联邦主义与医疗政策实施理论。
AI.method: 对34名州政府官员、医疗非营利组织官员、营利性游说者、医疗行业代表及其他医疗专家进行深度访谈。
AI.findings: 1. OBBBA将给Medicaid和ACA市场计划参与者带来大量新的行政和财务负担；2. 削减合法移民的医疗保险覆盖；3. 将Medicaid资金压力从联邦政府转嫁给各州；4. 州政策制定者对减少覆盖损失持悲观态度并面临诸多约束；5. 法案将在州和地方层面产生财政涟漪效应，导致Medicaid进一步削减。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"社会项目几乎不可能被 dismantle"的传统观点，展示了在特定政治策略和因素作用下，大规模削减社会项目仍可能实现；为医疗政策逆向变迁提供了实证分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、医疗行业从业者和公众理解OBBBA的真实影响提供了系统证据；揭示了各州在实施联邦医疗削减政策时面临的困境与约束；警示了医疗安全网的持续脆弱性。

title: Dialectic of Excise Taxation of Tobacco Products in Ukraine: Eurointegration Aspect
affiliations: , State Tax University, State Tax University and Independent Researcher

detail.title: Dialectic of Excise Taxation of Tobacco Products in Ukraine: Eurointegration Aspect
detail.abstract: The paper reveals the scientific approaches to the transformation of the excise taxation of tobacco products in order to achieve the objectives of fiscal consolidation and the fulfilment of the requirements of the Association Agreement with the EU. The tendencies of development of mechanisms of taxation of excise taxes on tobacco products in the EU countries in the context of new challenges and threats are analysed, and special attention was paid to the practice of raising the level of taxation of these excisable goods in certain EU countries. Problems in the realisation of the fiscal and regulatory potential of excise taxation of tobacco products in Ukraine are revealed. The directions of reformation of excise taxation of tobacco products in Ukraine are grounded, taking into account the requirements of EU directives and European experience.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了乌克兰为实现财政整顿目标并履行与欧盟的联系国协定要求，如何科学改革烟草产品消费税。研究分析了欧盟国家在新型挑战下烟草消费税机制的发展趋势，揭示了乌克兰在发挥烟草消费税财政与监管潜力方面存在的问题，并基于欧盟指令要求和欧洲经验提出了乌克兰烟草消费税改革方向。
AI.research_question: 如何科学改革烟草产品消费税，以实现财政整顿目标并满足与欧盟联系国协定的要求？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰面临财政整顿压力，同时需要履行与欧盟的联系国协定，因此需要借鉴欧盟经验改革烟草消费税制度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费税的财政功能与监管功能理论；欧盟税收协调与指令框架；财政整顿理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法（欧盟各国烟草消费税实践比较）；问题诊断法（识别乌克兰现行制度问题）；政策推演法（基于欧盟指令与经验提出改革方向）。
AI.findings: 欧盟国家在新型挑战下烟草消费税机制呈现特定发展趋势；乌克兰烟草消费税在财政和监管潜力的发挥上存在若干问题；基于欧盟指令和欧洲经验可提出乌克兰烟草消费税的改革方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了欧盟国家烟草消费税机制在新型挑战下的发展趋势；为转型经济体如何协调国内财政目标与国际协定要求提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰烟草消费税改革提供了具体方向建议；为其他面临类似财政整顿与欧盟一体化要求的国家提供了可借鉴的政策经验。

title: Signatures of Financial Markets
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Signatures of Financial Markets
detail.abstract: A track record is a stream: returns arriving in time, each beside a state of the market. Performance evaluation runs almost entirely on aggregates, the Sharpe ratio, the information ratio, Jensen's alpha, which summarise the return distribution and throw away order. We model a strategy as a multivariate path and apply the signature transform of rough-path theory, a reparametrisation-invariant graded feature set that records how performance and market stress interact through time with no parametric likelihood. A strategy's law is identifiable from its expected signature up to tree-like equivalence; style drift becomes a signature-kernel twosample test; and detection of state-dependent performance becomes anytime-valid, a signature conformance score turned into an e-process whose error is controlled at every sample size at once by Ville's inequality, with the null conditioned on the past so that volatility clustering and momentum do not break it. The discriminating coordinate is the signature's Lévy area, which measures whether returns rise exactly when the market turns hard, the antisymmetric lead-lag that the timing regressions of Treynor and Mazuy and of Henriksson and Merton discard. We prove that the Sharpe ratio, the information ratio, and every statistic of the return multiset are invariant under reordering returns in time, so a fund that aligns its reported gains with market states, the Madoff signature, matches an honest profile on every aggregate yet is exposed by the area. We are careful about what the area certifies: state-dependent convexity, shared by genuine timing, mechanical optionality, and reported-return fraud, with netting against a convexity benchmark as the attribution step. In a study calibrated to NASDAQ volatility the e-process holds exact type-I control, power rises with timing strength and record length, and a first-order growth law predicts detection time.

AI.tldr: 本文利用粗糙路径理论的签名变换（signature transform）对投资策略的业绩流进行时序分析，发现夏普比率等传统聚合指标忽略了回报的时间顺序，而签名中的Lévy面积能检测出状态依赖的业绩表现（如择时能力、欺诈行为），并构建了任意时刻有效的e-process检验框架。
AI.research_question: 如何利用回报的时间顺序信息（而非仅聚合统计量）来检测投资策略中的状态依赖业绩、风格漂移和潜在欺诈？
AI.motivation: 传统业绩评价（夏普比率、信息比率、Jensen's alpha等）仅基于回报分布的聚合统计量，完全忽略了回报到达的时间顺序，因此无法区分真实的择时能力与通过操纵回报时间（如Madoff式欺诈）制造的虚假业绩。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粗糙路径理论（rough-path theory）的签名变换（signature transform）；Ville不等式用于构造e-process；Treynor-Mazuy和Henriksson-Merton的择时回归模型。
AI.method: 将策略建模为多元路径（回报与市场状态随时间到达），应用签名变换提取重参数化不变的分级特征；构建签名核两样本检验（风格漂移检测）；基于签名一致性分数构造e-process（任意样本量下控制错误率的实时检验）。
AI.findings: (1) 夏普比率等聚合指标对回报的时间重排不变，因此无法检测Madoff式欺诈；(2) 签名的Lévy面积能捕获回报与市场状态的交互时序（即"回报是否在市场困难时上升"）；(3) e-process在NASDAQ波动校准下保持精确的I类错误控制，检测能力随择时强度和记录长度增强；(4) 一阶增长律可预测检测时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将粗糙路径理论的签名方法引入金融业绩评价，证明传统聚合指标的时间不变性，揭示Lévy面积作为判别择时、期权性和欺诈的关键特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实时监控策略业绩的e-process框架，能够检测风格漂移和状态依赖表现，并对Madoff式回报操纵具有识别能力。

title: Global Current Account Monitor: Regime Anchors and Exchange Rate Repricing Signals
affiliations: Laval University, Faculté des Sciences Sociales, Département d'Économique, Students

detail.title: Global Current Account Monitor: Regime Anchors and Exchange Rate Repricing Signals

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The sole author declares no competing financial or institutional interests.

detail.abstract:
This macro note monitors current account regimes across 16 sovereigns and regional aggregates using IMF World Economic Outlook data (April 2026), extracting exchange rate repricing signals through a non-parametric distributional framework. The 50 % Highest Density Region (HDR) anchors each sovereign's structural external financing gravity in realised outcomes rather than theoretical sustainability benchmarks. 
Breach of the HDR lower bound — signalling that the external liability position is expanding beyond the structural range — elevates the sovereign risk premium ψt, transmitting into exchange rate repricing through distinct regime contingent channels: continuous spot adjustment under floating regimes, and reserve depletion culminating in forced devaluation under fixed and pegged regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用IMF 2026年4月《世界经济展望》数据，通过非参数分布框架（50%最高密度区域）监测16个主权国家的经常账户制度，识别汇率重定价信号。当外部负债突破HDR下限时，主权风险溢价上升，并通过不同汇率制度渠道传导至汇率调整：浮动汇率下持续即期调整，固定汇率下储备耗尽引发强制贬值。
AI.research_question: 如何通过非参数分布框架监测主权国家经常账户制度，并识别汇率重定价信号？
AI.motivation: 传统的经常账户可持续性分析依赖理论基准，而本文采用基于实际结果的结构性外部融资引力（50% HDR）来锚定分析，以更准确地捕捉主权风险溢价变化及其对汇率的传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数分布框架（50%最高密度区域）、主权风险溢价理论、不同汇率制度下的汇率调整机制（浮动汇率持续调整 vs. 固定汇率储备耗竭）。
AI.method: 基于IMF WEO数据（2026年4月），采用非参数分布方法构建50% HDR，监测经常账户制度偏离信号，并区分浮动与固定汇率制度下的传导渠道。
AI.findings: HDR下限被突破（外部负债超出结构性范围）会推高主权风险溢价，进而通过两种渠道引发汇率重定价：浮动汇率制下表现为持续即期汇率调整，固定/盯住汇率制下表现为储备耗尽后的被迫贬值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出基于实际结果（而非理论基准）的50% HDR框架，用于锚定结构性外部融资引力，并系统性区分不同汇率制度下的主权风险溢价传导渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了一种基于数据的经常账户制度监测工具，可提前识别汇率重定价风险，区分浮动与固定汇率制度下的危机传导路径。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Strategic Communication, and Allocation

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Strategic Communication, and Allocation
detail.abstract: The paper studies strategic communication in allocation decisions. A receiver decides whether to allocate an object, such as a job, admission slot, grant, or contract, to an informed sender. The sender privately knows whether allocation would be desirable or undesirable for the receiver and privately chooses between two communication tests: a direct test or an AI-assisted test. The receiver observes a signal realization and a report about test use, forms beliefs, and decides whether to allocate. In equilibrium, AI-use declarations are uninformative cheap talk. AI matters instead through signal generation and the receiver's interpretation of signal realizations. The paper characterizes pure-strategy equilibria and derives welfarerelevant comparative statics: posterior dispersion improves the receiver's screening payoff, while a sender benefits when AI makes her communication more persuasive. The paper then studies which AI tests arise in equilibrium and how they affect welfare. AI that improves high-value senders' ability to produce credible signals supports certification, whereas AI that improves low-value senders' ability to resemble high-value senders supports imitation. If AI can only repackage information already contained in the direct test, then it cannot generate selective certification: certification requires new information, while imitation and pooling can arise from repackaging alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在分配决策中，发送者（如求职者）在直接测试与AI辅助测试间选择，接收者（如雇主）据此决定是否分配资源。AI使用声明是无信息含量的廉价交谈，AI通过信号生成和接收者对信号的解读来发挥作用。论文刻画了纯策略均衡，分析了福利比较静态，并研究了AI测试如何影响认证、模仿和混同均衡。
AI.research_question: 在分配决策中，当发送者可以私下选择直接测试或AI辅助测试进行战略沟通时，均衡结果如何？AI测试如何影响发送者的沟通策略、接收者的筛选效果以及总体福利？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在招聘、录取、拨款评审等分配决策中的广泛应用（如AI辅助简历筛选、面试评估等），亟需理解AI工具如何改变战略沟通的动态均衡，特别是发送者策略性选择测试方式对信息传递和分配效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号博弈理论、廉价交谈理论、贝叶斯信念更新、均衡筛选理论
AI.method: 博弈论建模与分析，刻画纯策略完美贝叶斯均衡，比较静态分析，福利分析。
AI.findings: 1) AI使用声明是廉价交谈，不传递信息；2) AI通过信号生成和接收者对信号的理解发挥作用；3) 后验离散度提高接收者筛选收益，发送者在AI使沟通更具说服力时受益；4) AI改善高价值发送者产生可信信号的能力时支持认证，改善低价值发送者模仿高价值发送者的能力时支持模仿；5) 仅重新包装直接测试已有信息的AI无法实现选择性认证，认证需要新信息，而模仿和混同可通过信息重新包装实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI辅助沟通纳入战略沟通理论框架，揭示了AI作为信号生成工具而非廉价交谈声明的本质作用；区分了AI支持认证与支持模仿的不同条件；证明了新信息对于选择性认证的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为招聘者、招生委员会、拨款评审机构等决策者提供AI工具使用的理论指导：AI能否改善筛选效果取决于它产生的是新信息还是仅重新包装现有信息；为政策制定者评估AI在资源配置中的角色提供分析框架。

title: The Dynamics of Ample Reserves
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: The Dynamics of Ample Reserves

keywords.keywords: monetary policy; liquid deposits; ample reserves; policy rate

detail.abstract: How monetary policy is implemented can have significant implications for the dynamics of the central bank's balance sheet. If liquid deposits increase the demand for reserves (Lopez-Salido and Vissing-Jorgensen 2025), then the "ample" level of reserves needed to close the spread between the policy rate and interest on reserves is itself a function of liquid deposits. The supply of reserves will continue to normalize after first reaching ample levels and until liquid deposits return to trend as well. Furthermore, if the supply of reserves encourages deposit creation (Acharya et al. 2024), then a feedback loop arises that can amplify the persistence of elevated deposits and even lead to explosive dynamics. An off-the-shelf calibration exercise finds that even modest amounts of intrinsic deposit persistence could trigger explosive dynamics. Attenuating the response of ample reserves to deposits removes the risk of instability at a modest cost in terms of rate deviations. Simulations with stable roots show that reserves first reach ample earlier and at a higher level than expected by the demand of reserves alone. However, the supply of reserves may decrease further thereafter, at least relative to trend, as liquid deposits remain elevated in the transition period. * The author would like to thank the Wharton Finance department for its hospitality, as well as James Clouse and audiences at the University of Miami and University of Houston for their feedback. The views expressed in this paper are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the views of the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia or the Federal Reserve System.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了货币政策实施方式对央行资产负债表动态的影响，发现流动性存款与准备金之间存在双向反馈循环，可能导致准备金和存款的持续性高企甚至爆炸性动态。校准分析表明，即使适度的存款内在持续性也可能触发不稳定性，而适度调整准备金对存款的响应可以消除风险。
AI.research_question: 货币政策实施如何通过流动性存款与准备金之间的双向反馈影响央行资产负债表的动态演变？
AI.motivation: 已有文献指出流动性存款会增加准备金需求（Lopez-Salido and Vissing-Jorgensen 2025），而准备金供给又可能刺激存款创造（Acharya et al. 2024），但两者之间的双向反馈机制及其对央行资产负债表稳定性的影响尚不清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均衡准备金需求理论；流动性存款与准备金的双向反馈模型；货币政策利率走廊理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与校准模拟分析（off-the-shelf calibration exercise），通过设定参数模拟准备金与存款的动态交互路径。
AI.findings: （1）准备金在首次达到"充足"水平的时间和规模上均高于仅考虑准备金需求时的预期；（2）流动性存款在过渡期内持续高企，导致准备金供给后续可能相对趋势进一步下降；（3）适度的存款内在持续性即可触发爆炸性动态；（4）减弱准备金对存款的响应幅度可消除不稳定风险，仅付出较小的利率偏离成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了准备金供给与流动性存款之间此前未被充分研究的双向反馈机制，指出该机制可能放大存款持续性并导致系统性不稳定。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行在实施货币政策时如何管理准备金供给以防止资产负债表失控提供了操作指引，特别是通过适度调节准备金对存款的响应来平衡稳定性与利率目标。

title: Screening with Product Mismatch
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: Screening with Product Mismatch
detail.abstract: A monopolist sells a product line whose variants are horizontally differentiated from the buyers' perspective but ordered by production cost. Buyers privately know their ideal product, and willingness to pay may be correlated with horizontal need. The seller screens buyers through product mismatch, and what she must screen determines whether mismatch creates or reduces information rent. When buyers differ only in horizontal need, mismatch creates rent: the seller induces less mismatch, assigning served buyers products closer to their ideals than under the first best. When willingness to pay is correlated with horizontal need, mismatch instead reduces rent: the seller induces more mismatch, sells the basic product to buyers whose efficient products are advanced variants while excluding buyers better matched to it, and stronger horizontal differentiation can expand coverage and raise profit. Because mismatch is type-specific, optimal allocations are determined by individual rationality rather than by incentive compatibility alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了垄断厂商在消费者存在水平差异化偏好且保留价格与需求相关时，如何通过产品不匹配来筛选消费者，并发现不匹配在某些情况下反而能降低信息租金。
AI.research_question: 垄断厂商如何在消费者具有私人水平偏好信息且支付意愿与需求相关的情况下，通过产品不匹配进行最优筛选？
AI.motivation: 传统筛选理论多关注垂直差异化（质量），而水平差异化下的最优定价与产品设计问题的理论研究尚不充分，尤其是当水平偏好与支付意愿存在相关性时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水平差异化筛选模型、信息租金理论、个人理性约束与激励相容约束的对比分析
AI.method: 理论建模与最优机制设计分析
AI.findings: （1）当消费者仅存在水平偏好差异时，不匹配产生信息租金，厂商减少不匹配程度；（2）当支付意愿与水平偏好相关时，不匹配反而降低信息租金，厂商会主动增加不匹配，将高效产品卖给不匹配的消费者，甚至排斥更匹配的消费者；（3）更强的水平差异化可以扩大市场覆盖并提高利润。
